Dholuo: Medruok mar tij pur e gwenge ma kech okethie ahinya mondo omi chiemo obedie e okang' momedore.

English: Increase harvest storage to ensure food security during droughts by preserving surplus from productive regions, reducing post-harvest losses, and enabling rapid distribution to affected areas.
Kiswahili: Ongeza uhifadhi wa mavuno ili kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula wakati wa ukame kwa kuhifadhi ziada kutoka kwa maeneo yenye tija, kupunguza upotezaji wa baada ya mavuno, na kuwezesha usambazaji wa haraka kwa maeneo yaliyoathiriwa.

Dholuo: Medore kuonde ma ipogo cham mondo omi chiemo obedie motegno e kinde ma kech nitie, kuom rito gik makonyo e alwora ma ji nyago, kuom dwoko chien gik ma ok nyalre bang' keyo, kendo kuom miyo ji thuolo mar pogo cham e alwora ma kech omako.

Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur ma Zambia mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo fwenyo tuwo mar manias ma bedo e tiendgi, tong'gi, kod kite ma nigi tuwo mar manias, kendo ging'e kama ginyalo yudoe gik ma ginyalo pidho manias ma onge tuoche.

English: Vegetable farmers should buy certified and treated seeds, unless growing organically, in which case seeds cannot be treated.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa mboga wanapaswa kununua mbegu zilizoidhinishwa na kutibiwa, isipokuwa kukua kikaboni, katika hali ambayo mbegu haziwezi kutibiwa.

Dholuo: Jogi onego ong'iew kodhi ma oseti gi ratiro kendo ma oselony, mak mana ka gipidhogi gi yien ma ok ochwe, kendo mano ok nyal miyo kodhi osetigo.

English: To treat chicken diarrhea naturally, some Tanzanian poultry farmers wash and cut ripe Aloe Vera leaves, squeeze out the juice, and mix it into the chickens' drinking water or feed - but consult a veterinarian first for the correct dosage for the chickens' age, and always keep the chicken house clean and provide a balanced diet alongside any natural remedy.
Kiswahili: Ili kutibu kuhara kwa kuku kwa kawaida, baadhi ya wafugaji wa kuku wa Tanzania huosha na kukata majani ya Aloe Vera yaliyoiva, kufinya juisi, na kuchanganya kwenye maji ya kunywa ya kuku au malisho - lakini wasiliana na daktari wa mifugo kwanza kwa kipimo sahihi cha umri wa kuku, na daima weka nyumba ya kuku safi na kutoa lishe bora pamoja na dawa yoyote ya asili.

Somali: Si ay u daaweeyaan ciridka digaagga si dabiici ah, qaar ka mid ah beeraleyda digaagga Tansaaniya waxay maydhaan oo gooyayaan caleemaha Aloe Vera ee bislaaday, waxay ku qasanayaan casiirka, waxayna ku qasi karaan biyaha digaagga ama quudinta - laakiin marka hore la tasho dhakhtarka xoolaha si aad u ogaatid qiyaasta saxda ah ee da'da digaagga, marwalba guriga digaagga si nadiif ah u ilaaliyo oo u siiya cunto dheelitiran oo ay la soc
Dholuo: Mondo ginyagre gi tuwo mar yadh-piende e yo makare, jopur moko ma pidho dhok e piny Tanzania lwoko kendo ng'ado kite ma osechopo e Aloe Vera, gichiwo pi ma gichuoyo, kae to gichiwe e pi modho kod chiemo ma gikwongo chamo - to mokwongo, ne laktar mar le mondo ong'e okang' mowinjore gi higni ma gikwongo tiyogo, kendo kinde duto rituru ot ma gikwongo chamo le kendo keturu chiemo mowinjore gi chiemo mapile.

English: Farmers using chemical pesticides against Fall armyworm should know when and how to use them safely, and how to store and clean the equipment and protective wear, to protect themselves, their families, and their communities.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaotumia kemikali za kuua wadudu dhidi ya minyoo aina ya Fall na jinsi ya kuzitumia kwa usalama, na jinsi ya kuhifadhi na kusafisha vifaa na nguo za kujikinga, kujilinda wenyewe, familia zao, na jumuiya zao.

Dholuo: Jo-Puriculture ma tiyo gi yedhe mamero mag choko yedhe mamero mag lweny onego ong'e kinde kod kaka ginyalo tiyo kodgi e yo makare, kendo kaka ginyalo kano kendo pwodho gik ma gilosogo kod lewni ma girwako mondo girit ngimagi, joodgi, koda ogandagi.

Somali: Beeraleyda, xoolo-dhaqatada, maamulayaasha kheyraadka biyaha, iyo hay'adaha khuseysa waxaa lagu talinayaa inay maalgeliyaan dalagyo wax soo saar sare leh oo biyaha u adkeysan, sida bariiska iyo tubers-ka.

Dholuo: Dhi nyime gi timo tijno e alwora ma pi opong'o, to moloyo e alwora ma pi opong'o Aora Gambia, ka gitiyo gi rieko e loyo pek ma pi nyalo kelo.

Kiswahili: Kutumia mazoea ya kilimo ya hali ya hewa ya busara ili kuongeza mavuno ya mazao na wanyama, hasa njia ambazo zinasimamia kwa ufanisi mvua nyingi.

Dholuo: Ti gi yore mag pur manyiso rieko e wi lokruok mar alwora mondo omi cham kod le mag chamo ring'o omed nyak maber, to moloyo, tiyo gi yore ma nyalo konyo e loyo koth mang'eny.

Kiswahili: Mvua inapoongezeka na udongo kujaa, wakulima wanatiwa moyo kutayarisha mashamba yao ifaavyo ili kupunguza mafuriko na kupunguza uharibifu wa mazao, kutia ndani kufanyiza mifereji ya kuondoa maji inapowezekana ili kuzuia maji yasipenye.

Dholuo: Kaka koth medore kendo lowo medo bedo mopong', ijiwo jopur mondo oik puothegi e yo makare mondo omi oketh nengo mar koth kendo omed ketho cham, moriwo nyaka loso yore mag ywayo pi kuonde ma nyalore mondo omi kik pi opong' piny.

English: Farmers are encouraged to plant water-resistant or flood-tolerant crop varieties to reduce losses, and to monitor crops regularly for signs of disease or stress caused by excess moisture.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kupanda aina za mazao yanayostahimili maji au yanayostahimili mafuriko ili kupunguza hasara, na kufuatilia mazao mara kwa mara kwa dalili za ugonjwa au mafadhaiko yanayosababishwa na unyevu kupita kiasi.

Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo opidh cham ma ok nyal yie gi pi kata ma ok nyal yie gi pi mondo omi okethgi, kendo mondo gine ka cham ma gipidhogo ok nyal nyagore gi tuwo moro kata ka ok ginyal yudo gik ma chando ji nikech pi.

English: Farmers are encouraged to move animals to higher ground to avoid flooding and reduce the risk of waterborne diseases, and to ensure animals are well-housed and hygienic to prevent disease outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuhamisha wanyama hadi maeneo ya juu ili kuepuka mafuriko na kupunguza hatari ya magonjwa yanayosababishwa na maji, na kuhakikisha wanyama wanakaa vizuri na wanasafi ili kuzuia milipuko ya magonjwa.

Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay xayawaanka u raro dhul sare si looga fogaado fatahaadaha loona yareeyo khatarta cudurrada biyaha ka baxa, iyo in xayawaanka si wanaagsan loo hoy iyo nadaafad leh si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada.

Kiswahili: Kukuza ustahimilivu na uzalishaji wa kilimo unaozingatia hali ya hewa katika maeneo ambayo yanategemea shughuli za mazao na mifugo.

Kiswahili: Ng'ombe wa maziwa wanapaswa kupata malisho bora na maji kwa angalau masaa 22 kwa siku, na wanahitaji masaa 12 hadi 14 ya kupumzika kila siku ambapo wanalala.

Kiswahili: Mazoea yanayopendekezwa ya uzalishaji wa shayiri ya kimea ni pamoja na upandaji wa safu, kupalilia na mifereji ya maji, pamoja na viwango vinavyofaa vya mbegu na uwekaji wa mbolea na kemikali kama vile dawa za kuulia wadudu na dawa za kuvu.

Dholuo: Yo ma ji tiyogo e loso shayiri mar malt en kaka pidho yiende, chwoyo ogolo, kod chwero yiende, kaachiel gi chwoyo kodhi mowinjore, kod tiyo gi yiende kod gik mamoko kaka yedhe makelo tho kod yedhe makelo tho.

Dholuo: Bang' keyo, inyalo ti gi moko kuom yiende mag kodhi e pidho jamni, kata inyalo weyogi e lowo kata iketogi e lowo mondo omi gimi ji nyak kendo gitim maber e kedo gi oro.

English: Farmers should always remove overripe mango fruits, since they provide breeding sites for fruit flies.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanapaswa kuondoa matunda ya embe yaliyoiva kila wakati, kwani hutoa maeneo ya kuzaliana kwa nzi wa matunda.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Pest management in mangoes" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-pest-management-mangoes/)

Dholuo: Jo-Puritan onego ogolga olemo mang'ongo ma osechopo tong'gi nikech olemo mang'ongo nigi kuonde ma olembe nyalo pidhoe.

English: Vines should be killed by uprooting or cutting at least 10 to 14 days before harvesting potatoes, to ensure that the skin of the tubers hardens.
Kiswahili: Mizabibu inapaswa kuuawa kwa kung'oa au kukata angalau siku 10 hadi 14 kabla ya kuvuna viazi, ili kuhakikisha kuwa ngozi ya mizizi inakuwa ngumu.

Dholuo: Olembe mag mzabibu onego oneg gi ng'olo kata ng'ado ng'injo ma ok tin ne odiechienge 10 nyaka 14 kapok gichoko olemo mag potasi, mondo omi pien olembe obed matek.

English: Farmers should prioritize planting disease-tolerant rice varieties with suitable maturity periods to achieve stable yields.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanapaswa kuweka kipaumbele cha kupanda aina za mchele zenye uvumilivu wa magonjwa na vipindi vya kukomaa vinavyofaa ili kufikia mavuno imara.

Dholuo: Kuom mano, jopur onego oket tong' mokwongo mar pidho kit loso loso kodhi ma nigi nyalo mar geng'o tuoche, kendo ma nigi kinde mowinjore mar chamo kodhi mondo giyud nyak maber.

English: When raising goats: let them graze/browse freely rather than keeping them indoors, feed them three times daily with water always available, separate unhealthy goats from healthy ones, only breed goats when protein-rich feed is plentiful, and make sure newborn kids suckle colostrum for 20-30 minutes after birth.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kufuga mbuzi: waache walishe/wavinjari kwa uhuru badala ya kuwaweka ndani ya nyumba, walishe mara tatu kila siku na maji yanapatikana kila wakati, tenganisha mbuzi wasio na afya kutoka kwa wenye afya, fuga mbuzi tu wakati malisho yenye protini ni nyingi, na uhakikishe watoto wachanga wananyonya kolostramu kwa dakika 20-30 baada ya kuzaliwa.

Somali: Marka la korinayo riyaha: u ogolow inay si xor ah u daaqsadaan/ku dhex dhex socdaan halkii ay guriga ku hayn lahaayeen, saddex jeer maalintii biyaha mar walba la heli karo, ri'da aan caafimaadka qabin kala sooc ri'da aan caafimaadka qabin iyo kuwa caafimaadka qaba, kaliya tarma riyaha marka cunto borotiin badan ay jirto, hubi in carruurta cusub ay nuujiyaan colostrum 20-30 daqiiqo kadib dhalashada.
Dholuo: Sama ipidho diek: wegi gicham le mag dhok ma ok giyiengni, miygi pi adek e odiechieng' kodiechieng' ka giyieng'o pi mapile, pog diek ma ok ler gi diek ma ngima, pidhi diek mana ka chiemo mopong' gi protein e iye, kendo rit ni nyithindo ma eka oa nyuol omodho colostrum kuom dakika 20-30 bang' nyuol.

English: To reduce post-harvest maize losses: harvest when the stalk withers and grains harden; if rain delays harvest, break the maize stem below the cob so it hangs down and doesn't absorb rainwater; dry maize on tarpaulins, mats, or raised racks (not on the ground) and keep animals away; and shell only when moisture content reaches 13-14%.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza hasara za mahindi baada ya mavuno: kuvuna wakati bua linapokauka; mvua ikikawia kunyesha, vunja shina la mahindi chini ya hindi ili lining'inia na kutofyonza maji ya mvua; mahindi makavu kwenye vitambaa, mikeka, au maboga yaliyoinuliwa (si kwenye ardhi) na kuzuia wanyama wasiingie; na kombe tu wakati unyevu unapofikia asilimia 13-14.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Reducing post-harvest losses in maize" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-reducing-post-harvest-losses-maize/)

Somali: Si loo yareeyo khasaaraha galleyda ka dib goosashada: goos marka geedka uu engecdo oo hadhuudhku adkaado; haddii roobku dib u dhaco goosashada, jebiso geedka galleyda hoosta si uu hoos ugu dhaco oo uusan nuugin biyaha roobka; galleyda qalalan ee tarpaulin, gogosha, ama racks kor loo qaaday (aan dhulka yaalin) oo xayawaanka ka fogeeyo; qolofka oo kaliya marka qoyaan uu gaaro 13-14%.
Dholuo: Mondo ng'ato odwok chien kethruok ma koth biro kelo: keyo ka yiend koth ochwe kendo cham bedo matek; ka koth ochwe, ket tong' mar koth piny e bwo tong' mondo ogur piny kendo kik omak pi koth; keyo ma otwo e pi, pi ma otwo, kata pi ma otwo (ok e lowo) kendo rit le mabor; kendo yienego mana ka pi ma otwo chopo 13-14%.

Kiswahili: Mbegu zilizosagwa zapasa kuhifadhiwa ndani ya jengo bila mianya ambapo wadudu kama vile wasagaji wa nafaka wakubwa zaidi au panya wanaweza kujificha au kuingia.

Dholuo: Kodhi mag cham onego okan e ot ma onge buche ma nyalo miyo chwanyruok obedie, kama chwanyruok kaka chwanyruok madongo mag kodhi kata chwanyruok nyalo pondo kata donjoe.

English: It is recommended that farmers plant improved sesame varieties that have been treated, are disease- and pest-free, and were sourced from certified and authorized seed producers.
Kiswahili: Inapendekezwa kwamba wakulima wapande aina za ufuta zilizoboreshwa ambazo zimetibiwa, hazina magonjwa na wadudu, na zilitolewa kutoka kwa wazalishaji wa mbegu walioidhinishwa na walioidhinishwa.

Dholuo: Omyero bene jo ma lugwok lim gupwony kit cembe ma kitgi ber ma dong kitimo maber, ma pe tye ki two nyo gin makwo, dok ma onongo gimiyo ki bot lupwony ma gimiyo cik.

Somali: Waxaa lagu talinayaa in beeraleyda ay beeraan noocyo yaanyada ah oo la wanaajiyay oo leh cimri dheer.
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo opidh kit pomade mabeyo ma nigi ndalo moromo.

English: Boma manure should be composted for at least 63 days before use, since the longer period also allows weed seeds to be eliminated.
Kiswahili: samadi ya Bola yapasa kutiwa mbolea kwa angalau siku 63 kabla ya kutumiwa, kwa kuwa kipindi kirefu zaidi pia huruhusu mbegu zilizosagwa ziondolewe.

Dholuo: Nyithindo ma ne nigi ich-go ne onego okaw mach kuom ndalo 63 kapok gitiyo kode, nikech kinde malachgo bende ne miyo ich-go kodhi mag ogolo.

English: Vaccinate your animals according to the recommendations given in your region, and always boil raw milk before you consume it, since this disease is life-threatening and more common in Kenya than in most other countries.
Kiswahili: Wasafishe wanyama wako kwa mujibu wa mapendekezo yaliyotolewa katika eneo lenu, na sikuzote chemsha maziwa yasiyopikwa kabla ya kuyala, kwa kuwa maradhi haya ni ya kufisha na ni ya kawaida zaidi nchini Kenya kuliko katika nchi nyingine nyingi.

Dholuo: Onego ichiw ripot mar kano le mari kaluwore gi kaka ikwayo e alworau, kendo nyaka iket chak ma ok oketie le kinde duto kapok ichame, nikech tuwo ma kamano nyalo hinyogo ngima dhano kendo en tuwo ma onya ahinya e piny Kenya moloyo pinje mamoko.

English: The recommended seed varieties are only guidelines; farmers are advised to contact local extension staff for other suitable varieties, since an area's climatic conditions can vary considerably.
Kiswahili: Aina za mbegu zilizopendekezwa ni miongozo tu; Wakulima wanashauriwa kuwasiliana na wafanyikazi wa ugani wa ndani kwa aina zingine zinazofaa, kwani hali ya hewa ya eneo inaweza kutofautiana sana.

Somali: Noocyada abuurka ee la soo jeediyay waa tilmaamo kaliya; Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay la xiriiraan shaqaalaha qaybinta maxalliga ah si ay u helaan noocyo kale oo ku habboon, maadaama xaaladaha cimilada ee deegaanka ay aad u kala duwanaan karaan.
Dholuo: Kodhi ma ji wacho ni onego okaw e yo maber gin mana chike ma tayo kaka onego okaw kodhi; omiyo, jodongo onego owuo gi joma tiyo e alwora ma gidhiye mondo giyud kodhi mamoko mowinjore nikech chal mar alwora nyalo pogore ahinya.

English: Local authorities such as county governments can impose quarantines to ensure tomatoes from affected areas are not transported to areas not affected by the pest.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka za mitaa kama vile serikali za kaunti zinaweza kuweka karantini ili kuhakikisha nyanya kutoka maeneo yaliyoathiriwa hazisafirishwi hadi maeneo ambayo hayajaathiriwa na wadudu.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 162, November 2018 (infonet-biovision.org)

Somali: Hay'adaha deegaanka sida dowladaha degmooyinka ayaa soo rogi kara karantiil si loo hubiyo in yaanyada ka yimaada meelaha ay saameysay aan loo qaadin meelaha aan cayayaanka saameyn.
Dholuo: Sirkande mag alwora kaka sirkande mag distrikt nyalo keto karantin mondo omi kik ter pomade e alwora ma chandoe.

English: Vaccinate your goats according to the recommendations made in your zone to avoid unnecessary losses.
Kiswahili: Chanja mbuzi wako kulingana na mapendekezo yanayotolewa katika ukanda wako ili kuepuka hasara isiyo ya lazima.

Somali: U tallaali orgihiinna sida ku cad talooyinka lagu bixiyay aaggaaga si looga fogaado khasaaraha aan loo baahnayn.
Dholuo: Tigo gi yedhe mamero mag dhok kaluwore gi chike ma yudore e alworau mondo kik ichulgi.

English: Suggestions for seeds will be based on seeds that you know are marketable, produce well, and withstand drought.
Kiswahili: Mapendekezo ya mbegu yatategemea mbegu unazozifahamu kuwa na soko, uzaaji mzuri, na zinazostahimili ukame.

Somali: Talooyinka abuurka waxay ku salaysan doonaan abuur aad ogtahay in ay suuq geyn karo, si fiican u soo saara, oo u adkeysta abaaraha.
Dholuo: Weche mibiro tiyogo e chwoyo kodhi biro luwore gi kodhi ma ing'eyo ni inyalo uso, ma nyago olemo maber, kendo ma nyalo nano e kinde oro.

English: It is wrong for farmers to apply any fertilizer without knowing what nutrients are lacking in the soil for the crop they intend to grow; farmers should seek advice from any KALRO station to have their soil tested.
Kiswahili: Ni makosa kwa wakulima kutumia mbolea yoyote bila kujua ni virutubisho gani vinakosekana kwenye udongo kwa mazao wanayokusudia kukua; wakulima wanapaswa kutafuta ushauri kutoka kwa kituo chochote cha KALRO ili kupima udongo wao.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 156, May 2018 (infonet-biovision.org)

Somali: Waa khalad in beeraleydu ay bacrimiyaan iyaga oo aan ogeyn nafteeda ka maqan ciidda dalagga ay rabaan inay koraan; beeraleydu waa inay talo ka raadsadaan saldhig kasta oo KALRO ah si ciiddooda loo tijaabiyo.
Dholuo: En gima rach ne jopur tiyo gi yien moro amora maok ging'eyo gik ma chiemo ok yud e lowo mondo gipidho cham ma gidwaro pidho.

English: Farmers can increase millet and sorghum yields profitably by using fertilizer in combination with organic and natural techniques that conserve and concentrate soil moisture and organic matter.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaweza kuongeza mavuno ya mtama na mtama kwa faida kwa kutumia mbolea pamoja na mbinu za kikaboni na asili ambazo huhifadhi na kuzingatia unyevu wa udongo na vitu vya kikaboni.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 32, January 2008 (infonet-biovision.org)

Somali: Beeraleydu waxay si faa'iido leh u kordhin karaan wax-soo-saarka millet iyo sorghum iyagoo adeegsanaya bacriminta iyo farsamooyinka organic iyo kuwa dabiiciga ah ee ilaaliya oo isku ururiya qoyaanka ciidda iyo walxaha organic-ka.
Dholuo: Jo-Puritan nyalo medo chamo cham mag millet kod sorghum e yo maber ka gitiyo gi yien ma nigi gik ma chamo pi kod mag lowo kaachiel gi gik mamoko ma chamo pi.

English: Farmers need access to information from research on how to farm sustainably, and indigenous knowledge should be prioritized in decisions that affect farmers.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahitaji kupata habari kutoka kwa utafiti juu ya jinsi ya kulima kwa uendelevu, na maarifa ya asili yanapaswa kupewa kipaumbele katika maamuzi ambayo yanaathiri wakulima.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 211, April 2023 (infonet-biovision.org)

Somali: Beeraleydu waxay u baahan yihiin helitaanka macluumaadka cilmi-baarista ee ku saabsan sida loo beero si joogto ah, aqoonta asaliga ahna waa in la mudnaanta siiyo go'aannada saameeya beeraleyda.
Dholuo: Jo-Puritan nyaka bed gi thuolo mar yudo weche ma yudore e nonro ma nyiso kaka ginyalo pidho puothegi e yo ma nigi nyak, kendo ng'eyo ma jopurgo nigo onego obed mokwongo e yiero ma gitimo.

English: Using a smartphone app, farmers can get a diagnosis of a crop disease and recommendations on what treatment to apply.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutumia programu ya smartphone, wakulima wanaweza kupata utambuzi wa ugonjwa wa mazao na mapendekezo juu ya matibabu gani ya kutumia.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 227, June 2025 (infonet-biovision.org)

Somali: Iyadoo la adeegsanayo app-ka taleefanka casriga ah, beeraleydu waxay heli karaan ogaansho cudur dalag ah iyo talooyin ku saabsan daaweynta la dabaqi karo.
Dholuo: Kuom tiyo gi app mar smartphone, jopur nyalo yudo ni gin gi tuwo moro e puothe kendo ginyalo yudo paro kuom kaka onego giti gi thiethno.

English: Although pyrethrum is quite poisonous when freshly harvested, it breaks down very quickly when exposed to the sun; after a few days there will be no poisonous compounds left and the produce will be safe to eat, though waiting one week is recommended to be absolutely sure.
Kiswahili: Ingawa pyrethrum ni sumu kabisa inapovunwa hivi karibuni, huvunjika haraka sana inapofunuliwa na jua; Baada ya siku chache hakutakuwa na misombo yenye sumu iliyobaki na mazao yatakuwa salama kuliwa, ingawa kusubiri wiki moja kunapendekezwa kuwa na uhakika kabisa.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 77, October 2011 (infonet-biovision.org)

Somali: Inkastoo pyrethrum uu sun badan yahay marka si cusub loo goosto, haddana si dhaqso ah ayuu u burburaa marka qorraxda la taago; Maalmo yar kadib wax walxo sun ah ma jiri doonaan, khudaartuna waa ammaan in la cuno, inkastoo la sugayo hal usbuuc si aad si buuxda u hubto.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni pyrethrum en gima nigi sum ahinya sama ogoye manyien, okethore mapiyo ahinya sama chieng' oyang'e; bang' ndalo matin, ok bi bedo gi sum moro amora kendo cham biro bedo maber, kata kamano, ber ka ng'ato rito juma achiel mondo obed gadier chuth.

English: Remove the freezing honey from the cloth using a spoon. Place the honey in a well-covered container.
Kiswahili: Ondoa asali inayoganda kwenye kitambaa kwa kutumia kijiko. Weka asali kwenye chombo kilichofunikwa vizuri.

Somali: Ka saar malabka qabow maro adigoo isticmaalaya qaaddo. Ku rid malabka weel si fiican loo daboolay.
Dholuo: Kaw meli ma ni e chiro kendo iket e agulu moting'o pi.

English: If rains are predicted as normal to below normal, select drought-tolerant varieties of the crops recommended for your area, or change to drought-tolerant crops - for example, replacing maize with sorghum and millet.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mvua zinatabiriwa kunyesha kiwango cha chini ya kiwango cha kawaida, chagua aina za mazao yanayostahimili ukame kwa eneo lako, au badilisha mazao na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame. Kwa mfano, badala ya mahindi unaweza kupanda mtama au uwele.

Somali: Haddii roobabka la saadaaliyo inay caadi ahaan u dhacaan ama ka hooseeyaan caadiga, dooro noocyo abaaro u dulqaadan kara oo lagu taliyo deegaankaaga, ama u beddela dalagyo abaaro u dulqaadan kara - tusaale ahaan, ku darso hadhuudhka iyo xiirka.
Dholuo: Kapo ni koth chue e alwora ma idakie, inyalo yiero kodhi ma nyalo nyagore gi pek mar yiengni, kata inyalo tiyo gi kodhi mamoko ma ok nyal nyagore gi pekno. Kuom ranyisi, inyalo loko kodhi mondo iti gi sorghum kod millet.

English: For rainfed agriculture, land should ideally be prepared at least two weeks before planting, with timing depending on when the rainy season is forecast to start, the crops being grown, and the topography.
Kiswahili: Kwa kilimo kinachotegemea mvua, shamba linapaswa kutayarishwa angalau wiki mbili kabla ya kupanda, kulingana na wakati msimu wa mvua unatarajiwa kuanza, zao litakalopandwa, na hali ya ardhi.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - OCR-extracted 2026-07-15 with tesseract (eng/swa+eng), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Beeraha roobka leh, dhulku waa in si fiican loo diyaariyaa ugu yaraan laba toddobaad ka hor beerista, iyadoo waqtiga ay kuxirantahay marka xilli roobku la saadaalinayo inuu bilaabo, dalagga la beero, iyo topography.
Dholuo: Kuom wach pur, lowo onego obed moik kata mana jumbe ariyo kapok ochwoyo, kendo onego ochak chwoyo ka ok ochuno ni ochak koth, kodhi ma ipidho, kod alwora ma koth ochakoree.

English: If rains are predicted as normal, apply organic fertilizer one to two weeks before planting in bunds or by spreading, followed by shallow tillage; if rains are below normal, apply organic fertilizer two to three weeks before planting.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mvua ni za kiwango cha kawaida, tumia mbolea ya asili wiki moja hadi mbili kabla ya kupanda kwenye malundo au kwa kusambaza kukifuatiwa na upaliliaji mwepesi; ikiwa mvua zinatabiriwa kunyesha chini ya kiwango cha kawaida, tumia mbolea ya asili wiki mbili hadi tatu kabla ya kupanda.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - OCR-extracted 2026-07-15 with tesseract (eng/swa+eng), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Haddii roobku si caadi ah u saadaaliyo, bacriminta organic ah ku mari hal ilaa laba toddobaad ka hor inta aan la beerin bunds ama adigoo faafinaya, kadibna beero si qoto dheer loo beero; Haddii roobku ka hooseeyo caadiga, isticmaal bacriminta organic laba ilaa saddex toddobaad ka hor beerta.
Dholuo: Kapo ni koth chue, onego iti gi yiendno jumbe achiel kata ariyo ka pok ipidho yiendni, kae to iti gi puodho matin.

English: Wait for the rains to start, and plant when the soil is moist enough - at least 20mm of rainfall over four consecutive days, or two days of heavy rain - or follow the advice from meteorology.
Kiswahili: Subiri hadi mvua zianze kunyesha, na panda wakati ardhi ina unyevu wa kutosha - angalau milimita 20 za mvua kwa siku nne mfululizo, au siku mbili za mvua kubwa - au fuata ushauri wa hali ya hewa.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - OCR-extracted 2026-07-15 with tesseract (eng/swa+eng), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Sug roobka, oo beero marka ciidda ay qoyan tahay - ugu yaraan 20mm oo roob ah afar maalmood oo isku xigta, ama laba maalmood oo roob xoog leh - ama raac talooyinka cimilada.
Dholuo: Rit mondo koth ochak chwe, kendo chuo ka lowo nigi pi moromo - kuom ndalo ang'wen ma luwore, kata kuom ndalo ariyo ma koth maduong' chwe - kata luw puonj mag weche mag kor lwasi.

English: Weeding can be done manually or with herbicides; when using herbicides, use the correct product, wear the correct protective clothing, and follow correct disposal of containers. Weed more often when rains are heavy, and less often when rains are light.
Kiswahili: Palizi inaweza kufanywa kwa kutumia mikono au kwa dawa ya kuua magugu; wakati wa kutumia dawa za kuua magugu, tumia dawa inayofaa, vaa nguo sahihi za kujikinga, na uzingatie utupaji sahihi wa vyombo vya dawa baada ya kutumia. Wakati wa mvua nyingi, palilia magugu mara nyingi zaidi, na ikiwa mvua ni chache, punguza upaliliaji.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - OCR-extracted 2026-07-15 with tesseract (eng/swa+eng), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Xadhigga cawska waxaa lagu samayn karaa gacanta ama iyada oo loo marayo jeermis-demmayaal; marka la isticmaalo jeermis-demmayaal, isticmaal alaabta saxda ah, xir dharka difaaca saxda ah, oo raac baabi'inta saxda ah ee weel.
Dholuo: Ka itiyo gi yedhe mamero yien, ti gi gik makare, rwakri gi lewni mowinjore, kendo iket gik ma inyalo ting'o e bwo yien.

English: For grains and legumes, harvest when the crop is completely dry; do not dry the harvest on bare soil, but spread a mat and store it in a dry, cool place. If rains are predicted, consider harvesting early and drying quickly.
Kiswahili: Kwa nafaka na mikunde, ni muhimu kuvuna wakati mazao yamekauka kabisa; usikaushe kwenye mchanga, bali tandaza mkeka na hifadhi mavuno katika sehemu kavu na baridi. Ikiwa mvua zinategemewa kunyesha, fikiria kuvuna mapema na kukausha haraka.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - OCR-extracted 2026-07-15 with tesseract (eng/swa+eng), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Beeraha iyo dhirta layslaado goosashada markaad dhimanayso, hana ku qalajin dhulka oo aan waxba lahayn, laakiin ku dheji sariir, oo meel qallalan oo qabow ku kaydi.
Dholuo: Ka cham kod yiende otwo, keyo ka cham otwo chuth; kik ipwodhgi e lowo maonge gik moko, to ketgi e lowo motwo kendo iketgi kama ng'ich.

English: Whenever possible, it is advised not to sell immediately after harvest when prices are low; harvest appropriately, store correctly, and sell when prices are higher.
Kiswahili: Inashauriwa, inapowezekana, kutouza mara tu baada ya mavuno wakati bei ziko chini; vuna ipasavyo, hifadhi vizuri, na uuze wakati bei ziko juu.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - OCR-extracted 2026-07-15 with tesseract (eng/swa+eng), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Mar kasta oo ay suurtagal tahay, waxaa lagugula talinayaa inaadan iibin isla markiiba goosashada kadib marka qiimaha ay hooseeyaan; goosashada si habboon, kaydinta si sax ah, iyo iibinta marka qiimaha ay sareeyaan.
Dholuo: Kinde duto, ok onego ohala mapiyo bang' keyo ka nengo piny; onego ohala e yo mowinjore, kendo onego okan kare, kendo ohala ka nengo ng'eny.

English: Based on the seasonal rainfall forecast, adopt appropriate soil and water conservation measures: if rains are predicted above normal, focus on controlling erosion, protecting crops from flooding, and water harvesting; if below normal, focus on conserving soil moisture. If your land is sloping, add contour bunds to prevent soil erosion.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na utabiri wa msimu wa mvua, zingatia mbinu sahihi za kuhifadhi udongo na maji: ikiwa mvua zinatarajiwa kuwa nyingi kuliko kawaida, zingatia kudhibiti mmomonyoko wa udongo, kulinda mazao dhidi ya mafuriko, na kuvuna maji; ikiwa mvua zitakuwa chini ya kawaida, zingatia kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo. Ikiwa ardhi yako iko mteremkoni, jenga matuta ili kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - decision #2 (soil/water conservation), text-bundle extraction 2026-07-15 (not previously captured), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Marka la eego saadaasha roobabka xilliyeedka, qaado tallaabooyinka saxda ah ee ilaalinta ciidda iyo biyaha: haddii roobabka la saadaaliyo ay ka sarreeyaan caadiga ah, diiradda saar xakamaynta burburka, ilaalinta dalagga fatahaadaha, iyo goosashada biyaha; haddii caadiga ka hooseeyo, diiradda saar ilaalinta qoyaanada ciidda. Haddii dhulku u jiifsan yahay, ku dar xidhmo xidhmo si looga hortago burburka ciidda.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi kaka koth biro chue e kinde mag oro, kaw chenro mar rito lowo kod pi: ka koth chue moloyo kaka ne iparo, ket pachi kuom rito yien mondo kik kethre, rit cham kik chue, kendo ket pachi kuom choko pi; ka ok ochue, ket pachi kuom rito yuto mar lowo.

English: Fertilizer can be organic, such as manure, or inorganic, or a mix of both; select the right fertilizer mix based on your soil, the crops you are growing, and the seasonal forecast.
Kiswahili: Mbolea inaweza kuwa ya asili, mfano samadi, au ya viwandani, au mchanganyiko wa aina zote mbili; chagua mchanganyiko sahihi wa mbolea kulingana na rutuba ya udongo wako, mazao unayopanda, na utabiri wa msimu.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - decision #4 (fertilizer type/mix selection), text-bundle extraction 2026-07-15 (not previously captured), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Bacriminta waxay noqon kartaa mid dabiici ah, sida bacriminta, ama aan dabiici ahayn, ama isku dar ah labadaba; dooro bacriminta saxda ah iyadoo ku saleysan ciiddaada, dalagyada aad korayso, iyo saadaasha xilliyeedka.
Dholuo: Yien ma inyalo chamo nyalo bedo mar chamo yien, kata mar chamo yien, kata mar chamo yien ma ok ochwe, kata onyalo bedo mar chamo yien ma ok ochwe.

English: Some pests and diseases occur when the weather is dry and others when there is heavy rain, so understand how the dynamics of major pests and diseases affecting your crops relate to the weather forecast, and identify which pesticides may be needed, where to obtain them, and how to use them correctly.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya wadudu waharibifu na magonjwa hutokea wakati hali ya hewa ni kavu na wengine hutokea wakati kuna mvua nyingi, hivyo elewa jinsi mienendo ya wadudu na magonjwa makuu ya mazao yako inavyohusiana na utabiri wa hali ya hewa, kisha bainisha viuatilifu vinavyohitajika, mahali vinapopatikana, na jinsi ya kuvitumia kwa usahihi.
Source: CGSpace/CCAFS-IITA "Climate smart agriculture: top ten decisions to make with weather info" poster - decision #8 (pest/disease management), text-bundle extraction 2026-07-15 (not previously captured), aligned by matching section headings between EN+SW versions (cgspace.cgiar.org items 62fd7239.../c4d42102...)

Somali: Qaar ka mid ah cayayaanka iyo cudurrada waxay dhacaan marka cimiladu qalalan tahay, kuwa kalena marka roob culus jiro, sidaas darteed faham sida isbeddelka cayayaanka iyo cudurrada waaweyn ee saameeya dalaggaaga ay la xiriiraan saadaasha cimilada, oo ogow cayayaanka cayayaanka loo baahan karo, meesha laga heli karo, iyo sida si sax ah loo isticmaalo.
Dholuo: Nitie tuoche moko ma nyalo timore sama piny ok yweyo kendo nitie mamoko ma nyalo timore sama koth chue, omiyo ng'e kaka tuoche madongo ma nyalo kelo tuoche kod tuoche e puothegi otudore gi kaka kor lwasi biro chalo, kendo ng'e kaka inyalo yudo yedhe mamero, kama inyalo yudoe kod kaka inyalo tiyo kodgi e yo makare.

English: To inoculate soybean seed, mix a sugar-water sticker solution, coat the seed evenly with it, then add the rhizobium inoculant and mix gently until every seed is covered; protect the inoculated seed from direct sunlight and keep it in the shade until you plant it.
Kiswahili: Ili kuchanja mbegu ya soya, changanya suluhisho la stika ya maji ya sukari, paka mbegu sawasawa nayo, kisha ongeza chanjo ya rhizobium na changanya kwa upole hadi kila mbegu ifunikiwe; Linda mbegu iliyochanjwa kutoka kwa jua moja kwa moja na kuiweka kwenye kivuli hadi uipande.
Source: CGSpace/N2Africa "Better soybean through good agricultural practices" leaflet, July 2014, For farmers in Ethiopia (CC-licensed) - Step 3: Inoculation excerpt, 2026-07-15 (cgspace.cgiar.org item 1c59e0c8-2fd5-4288-af93-7d585e4aea8a, handle 10568/76318)

Somali: Si aad u tallaalto abuurka soy-ya, isku qas xalka sticker sonkor-biyo, ku shub abuurka si siman u dabool, kadibna ku dar inoculant-ka rhizobium oo si tartiib ah u qas ilaa abuur kasta la daboolo; Ilaali abuurka la tallaalay si toos ah uga soo baxa qorraxda tooska ah oo ku hay hooska ilaa aad beerto.
Dholuo: Mondo iketh kodhi mag soya, iketh ng'injo mar sukari gi pi, iket kodhi e yo mochanore kode, kae to iket gi yath mar rhizobium kendo iket kode mos nyaka kodhi ka kodhi opong'; rit kodhi moket e yath kik hiny ler mar chieng' kendo ketgi e tipo nyaka ipidhgi.

English: Common pests affecting soybean in Ethiopia are the African bollworm, cutworm, green stink bug, and aphid; leaf damage alone is unlikely to reduce yield and does not need spraying, but from flowering onwards soybean becomes attractive to pod-sucking bugs that can seriously reduce seed quality.
Kiswahili: Wadudu wa kawaida wanaoathiri soya nchini Ethiopia ni bollworm ya Kiafrika, minyoo, mdudu wa kijani kibichi, na aphid; Uharibifu wa majani pekee hauwezekani kupunguza mavuno na hauhitaji kunyunyiziwa dawa, lakini kutoka kwa maua na kuendelea soya inavutia mende wanaonyonya ganda ambao wanaweza kupunguza sana ubora wa mbegu.
Source: CGSpace/N2Africa "Better soybean through good agricultural practices" leaflet, July 2014, For farmers in Ethiopia (CC-licensed) - pest section excerpt, 2026-07-15 (cgspace.cgiar.org item 1c59e0c8-2fd5-4288-af93-7d585e4aea8a, handle 10568/76318)

Somali: Xadgudubyada caadiga ah ee saameynaya soybean ee Itoobiya waa cayayaanka Afrikaanka, cutworm, cayayaanka cagaaran ee qadhaadhka ah, iyo afid; dhaawaca caleenta oo keliya ma aha mid u badan in ay yareyso wax soo saarka mana u baahan tahay buufinta, laakiin laga bilaabo ubaxyada soybean wuxuu u soo jiidanayaa cayayaanka nuugaya budada oo si weyn u yareyn kara tayada abuurka.
Dholuo: Pests ma onya ahinya e piny Ethiopia gin kaka African bollworm, cutworm, green stink bug, kod aphid; kethruok mar yien kende ok nyal miyo cham okethre kendo ok ochuno ni nyaka ochweye, kata kamano, chakre ka giseyudore, soybe bedo mayot mondo oyudgo bug ma chuyo kodhi.

English: Climbing bean varieties yield more per unit of land than bush varieties but need staking for support; the highest yields come from stakes at least 175cm long, using at least 20,000 stakes per hectare, started two weeks after germination.
Kiswahili: Aina ya maharagwe ya kupanda huzaa zaidi kwa kila kitengo cha ardhi kuliko aina za kichaka lakini zinahitaji staking kwa msaada; mavuno ya juu huja kutoka kwa stakes angalau 175cm ya urefu, kwa kutumia stakes angalau 20,000 kwa hekta, ilianza wiki mbili baada ya kilimo.
Source: CGSpace/N2Africa "Better beans through good agricultural practices" leaflet, July 2014, For farmers in Ethiopia (CC-licensed) - staking climbing beans excerpt, 2026-07-15 (cgspace.cgiar.org item 3be2c6b5-0c6c-4078-b7c7-8edc90503d3a, handle 10568/76317)

Somali: Noocyada digirta kor u kaca waxay helaan wax ka badan noocyada bush halkii unug dhul ah balse waxay u baahan yihiin in la garaaco si loo taageero; Wax-soosaarka ugu sarreeya wuxuu ka yimaadaa tiirarka ugu yaraan 175cm dheer, iyadoo la isticmaalayo ugu yaraan 20,000 stake halkii hektar, taasoo bilaabatay laba toddobaad kadib dhalasha.
Dholuo: Yien mag nyinyo ma wuok e puothe mag goro ma ng'ato nyalo wuothogo e puothe mar lowo ng'eny moloyo mag puothe mag bungu, kata kamano dwarore ni okonygi gi yien; yien ma nigi nyalo mar romo sentimita 175 kende, ma nigi tong' 20,000 e hekta, chakore bang' jumbe ariyo ka gisechwo.

English: Bean stem maggot can be controlled through early planting, crop rotation, earthing up soil around the stem during weeding, using tolerant varieties, or treating seed with a systemic insecticide before planting.
Kiswahili: Funza wa shina la maharagwe yanaweza kudhibitiwa kupitia upandaji mapema, mzunguko wa mazao, kuweka udongo kuzunguka shina wakati wa kupalilia, kutumia aina zinazostahimili, au kutibu mbegu kwa dawa ya kuua wadudu kabla ya kupanda.
Source: CGSpace/N2Africa "Better beans through good agricultural practices" leaflet, July 2014, For farmers in Ethiopia (CC-licensed) - bean stem maggot control excerpt, 2026-07-15 (cgspace.cgiar.org item 3be2c6b5-0c6c-4078-b7c7-8edc90503d3a, handle 10568/76317)

Somali: Cayayaanka digirta waxaa lagu xakameyn karaa iyadoo la beerayo hore, wareegga dalagyada, ciidda lagu dhejiyo hareeraha lafta inta lagu jiro cawska cawska, isticmaalka noocyada adkaysi leh, ama daaweynta abuurka iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaanka nidaamsan ka hor inta aan la beerin.
Dholuo: Nyak mag tong' mar puodho inyalo geng'o ka ipidhogi chon, ka ipidhogi e kinde ma cham chako pong', ka ipidhogi e lowo, ka itiyo gi kit yiende ma ok nyal yie gi yiendgi, kata ka itiyo gi yedhe mamero kodhi ma ok nyal geng'o ichwoyo.

English: Rotate soybean with maize or sorghum for soil fertility benefits and disease control.
Kiswahili: Badilisha soya na mahindi au mtama ili kuimarisha rutuba ya udongo na kuzuia magonjwa.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=checklist; urgency=low; source_pair=true; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.738; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.575
Somali: Ku beddel soybean-ka galley ama sorghum si aad u hesho faa'iidooyinka bacrinta ciidda iyo xakamaynta cudurrada.
Dholuo: Ti gi soya gi cham mar cham kata sorghum mondo omi lowo obed maber kendo mondo oti gi tuoche.

English: Test the seeds for germination and plant only when germination is above 80%.
Kiswahili: Jaribu mbegu ya soya kama inamea kabla ya kupanda ili kuthibitisha kwamba asilimia zaidi ya 80 inamea.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=checklist; urgency=low; source_pair=true; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.743; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.41
Somali: Tijaabi abuurka si loo ogaado in uu dhirta ku soo baxaa iyo dhirta kaliya marka dhirta ay ka sarreyso 80%.
Dholuo: Tem ane mondo ine kodhi kod yien ka gisewuok gi nyak mokalo 80%.

English: Plant on time, when the soil is moist at the onset of the first rains; roots will not grow into dry soil and will not survive in water-logged soil.
Kiswahili: Panda kwa wakati ufaao, hakikisha mchanga una unyevu wa kutosha hasa wakati wa mvua za mwanzo. Mizizi ya soya haiwezi kustahimili mchanga mkavu ama mchanga wenye maji mengi.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)

Somali: Beerta waqtigeeda, marka ciiddu qoyan tahay marka roobka ugu horreeya bilowdo; xididdadu ma koraan dhul qalalan mana ku noolaan doonaan ciidda biyaha ku buuxdaan.
Dholuo: Ket yien e kinde mowinjore, sama lowo nigi pi mang'ich e kinde ma koth chakore; tiende ni mise ok bi dongo mobedo lowo motwo kendo ok gibi siko e lowo mopong' gi pi.

English: Spray recommended fungicide at recommended rates, first at flowering and once again as recommended, usually 21 days after the first spraying.
Kiswahili: Tumia dawa ya kuzuia magonjwa iliyopendekezwa, kwa kiwango kilichopendekezwa, wakati soya inapoanza kuweka maua. Rudia kunyunyizia dawa, kulingana na maagizo, kwa kawaida siku 21 baada ya kunyunyiza mara ya kwanza.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)

Somali: Ku buufi fungicide-ka lagu taliyay heerar la soo jeediyay, marka hore marka ubaxa ubaxa, mar kale sida lagu taliyey, badanaa 21 maalmood kadib buufinta ugu horreysa.
Dholuo: Ochiw fungicide e okang ' ma ikwayo, mokwongo ka odongo kendo bang ' ndalo 21 bang ' ka osetime chwero.

English: Harvest early when 90-100% of pods are brown and dry, but before they become brittle and shatter.
Kiswahili: Vuna mapema wakati asilimia 90 hadi 100 ya mizoga imekauka na kubadilika kuwa rangi ya hudhurungi, lakini kabla haijaanza kupasuka.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=checklist; urgency=medium; source_pair=true; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.792; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.61
Somali: Goosto hore marka 90-100% xayawaanka ay yihiin bunni oo qalalan yihiin, laakiin ka hor inta aysan jabin oo burburin.
Dholuo: Ikayo cham chon ka pasent 90 nyaka 100 mag puothe gin makwar kendo maboyo, to kapok gibedo motuwo kendo maboyo.

English: Clean the grain and dry it to a moisture content of 11-12%; soybeans above 13% moisture are likely to mould, and grain dried below 11% is likely to crack.
Kiswahili: Ondoa uchafu kwenye mbegu na ukaushe hadi unyevu ufike asilimia 11-12; soya zenye unyevu zaidi ya asilimia 13% huenda zikaoza, na ukikausha zaidi ya asilimia 11 mbegu zitapasuka.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=checklist; urgency=medium; source_pair=true; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.856; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.457
Somali: Nadiifi hadhuudhka oo qalaji ilaa qoyaan u dhexeeya 11-12%; Soybeans-ka ka sarreeya 13% qoyaan ayaa u badan inuu cadhigo, halka hadhuudhka la qalajiyay ee ka hooseeya 11% ay u badan tahay inay dillaacaan.
Dholuo: Ler cham kendo tur iye nyaka bed gi mor mar 11-12%; cham ma nigi mor mar soybe ma okalo 13% nyalo bedo gi muya, to cham ma nigi mor mar bedo matin moloyo 11% nyalo bedo gi ywaruok.

English: Store dry, clean grain only in clean bags - never recycled fertilizer, pesticide, or other chemical bags - and keep it in a cool, dry, ventilated place.
Kiswahili: Weka nafaka safi na iliyokauka kwenye magunia safi tu - usitumie magunia yaliyotumika kubeba mbolea, dawa za wadudu, au kemikali nyingine - na uhifadhi mahali penye ubaridi, ukavu, na hewa ya kutosha.
Source: N2Africa "Best practices to maintain high yields and grain quality of soybean" checklist, for farmers in west Kenya - genuine EN+Swahili bilingual document (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Best practice_soybean_English-Kiswahili.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=checklist; urgency=low; source_pair=true; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.962; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.667
Somali: Ku kaydi hadhuudhka qalalan oo nadiif ah oo kaliya bacaha nadiifka ah - waligaa ha dib u warshadayn bacriminta, cayayaanka, ama bacaha kiimikada kale - kuna hay meel qabow, qalalan oo hawo leh.
Dholuo: Ket cham ma ok ler e bag maler kende - ok onego ilos gi yien, yedhe mamero kod kembe mamoko - kendo ketgi kama ng'ich, ma ok ler kendo ma onge muya.

English: Harvest the nuts when they are well ripe; Harvesting prematurely leads to a loss of yield, and late harvesting causes the nuts to become poisoned by the fungus (aflatoxin).
Kiswahili: Vuna karanga wakati zimekomaa vizuri; kuvuna kabla ya wakati kunasababisha kupoteza mavuno, na kuchelewa kuvuna kunasababisha karanga kuingiwa na sumu kuvu (aflatoxin).
Source: Makutupora Agricultural Research Institute / N2Africa "Ongeza mavuno ya karanga kwa kutumia mbinu bora za kilimo" (Tanzania groundnut brochure) - Swahili-original, no English source exists (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Groundnut Brochure, Tanzania.pdf)

Somali: Goosta lowska marka ay si fiican u bisilaan; Goosashada si degdeg ah waxay keentaa in la waayo wax-soo-saarka, goosashada dambe waxay keentaa in lowska ay sun ku dhacdo fangaska (aflatoxin).
Dholuo: Ka ipogo cham kapok ochopo e sa ma cham ochakoree, to cham biro lal, to ka ipogo cham mochopo bang'e, to cham biro bedo gi tuwo mar aflatoxin.

English: Store well-dried nuts in clean sacks and a clean, dry and moisture-free warehouse; use a biological remedy such as Aflasafe, if available, following the advice of specialists, to control fungal poisoning.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi karanga zilizokauka vizuri kwenye magunia safi na ghala safi, kavu na yasiyo na unyevu; tumia dawa ya kibaiolojia kama Aflasafe, ikiwa inapatikana, kwa kufuata ushauri wa wataalamu, ili kudhibiti sumu kuvu.
Source: Makutupora Agricultural Research Institute / N2Africa "Ongeza mavuno ya karanga kwa kutumia mbinu bora za kilimo" (Tanzania groundnut brochure) - Swahili-original, no English source exists (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Groundnut Brochure, Tanzania.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=extension brochure; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=sw; country=Tanzania; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.913; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.776; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.54
Somali: Ku kaydi lowska si fiican loo qalajiyey boorsooyin nadiif ah iyo bakhaar nadiif ah, qalalan oo aan qoyan lahayn; isticmaal daawo bayooloji ah sida Aflasafe, haddii la heli karo, adigoo raacaya talada khubarada, si loo xakameeyo sunta fangaska.
Dholuo: Ket tong' ma oseyueyo maber e bag maler kendo e kar kano maler, ma onge pi, kendo ma onge ng'ich; ti gi yath mar thieth kaka Aflasafe, kapo ni nitie, ka luwore gi kaka lakteche osechiwo, mondo omi kik chungo ng'ato gi sum.

English: Legumes should be harvested when they are well dried; Harvest by picking the stumps or plucking the stems after all the stumps have dried.
Kiswahili: Kunde zivunwe wakati zimekauka vizuri; vuna kwa kuchuma vitumba au kung'oa mashina baada ya vitumba vyote kukauka.
Source: Ilonga Agricultural Research Institute / N2Africa "Lima kunde kwa lishe na kipato zaidi" (Tanzania cowpea brochure) - Swahili-original, no English source exists (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Cowpea Brochure Tanzania.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=extension brochure; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=sw; country=Tanzania; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.814; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.68; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.489
Somali: Digirta waa in la goosaa marka ay si fiican u qalageen; Goosashada adigoo gooyaa stumps-ka ama la gooyaa laamaha ka dib marka dhammaan stumps-ka ay engegaan.
Dholuo: Olembe onego okwang' ka oseyueyo maber; onego okwang'gi ka ichoko yiende kata ka ichoko yiende bang' ka yiende duto oseyueyo.

English: After harvesting, the buds are soaked in sunlight, sliced, sliced, and then dried again until they are well dry; since the buds are easily attacked by insects, store them in special bags (PICS).
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuvuna, anika kunde juani, zipige kwa fito, zipete, kisha zikaushe tena juani hadi zikauke vizuri; kwa kuwa kunde hushambuliwa haraka na wadudu, zihifadhi kwenye mifuko maalum (PICS bags).
Source: Ilonga Agricultural Research Institute / N2Africa "Lima kunde kwa lishe na kipato zaidi" (Tanzania cowpea brochure) - Swahili-original, no English source exists (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Cowpea Brochure Tanzania.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=extension brochure; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=sw; country=Tanzania; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.766; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.876; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.588
Somali: Kadib goosashada, ubaxyada waxaa lagu qoyiyaa iftiinka qorraxda, la jarjaray, la jarjaray, kadibna mar kale waa la qalajiyaa ilaa ay si fiican u engegaan; maadaama budada si fudud ay cayayaanka u weeraraan, ku kaydi bacaha gaarka ah (PICS).
Dholuo: Bang' keyo, ipidho puothego e ler mar chieng', kae to ipogo, ipogo, kae to ipogo kendo nyaka gibed motimo yien; nikech chokego nyalo monjo gi choke, onego okan e bag makende.

English: To treat vegetable seeds against disease before sowing, submerge them in water heated to the recommended temperature for the recommended time (for example, spinach, cabbage, pepper, tomato and eggplant: 50°C for 30 minutes; lettuce and celery: 47°C for 30 minutes), then cool the seeds immediately in clean water and dry them before sowing or storing.
Kiswahili: Ili kutibu mbegu za mboga dhidi ya magonjwa kabla ya kupanda, zitumbukize kwenye maji yenye joto kali kwa joto lililopendekezwa kwa wakati uliopendekezwa (kwa mfano, mchicha, kabichi, pilipili, nyanya na biringanya: 50 ° C kwa dakika 30; lettuce na celery: 47 ° C kwa dakika 30), kisha upoe mbegu mara moja kwenye maji safi na uikaushe kabla ya kupanda au kuhifadhi.

Somali: Si loo daaweeyo miraha dhirta cudurrada ka hor inta aan la beerin, ku qasi biyo lagu kululeeyo heerkulka lagula talinayo waqtiga lagula talinayo (tusaale ahaan, spinach, caws, qumbaha, yaanyada iyo eggplant: 50 °C 30 daqiiqo; lettuce iyo celery: 47 °C 30 daqiiqo), ka dibna si dhakhso leh u qabooji miraha biyaha nadiifka ah oo qalaji iyaga ka hor inta aan la beerin ama lagu kaydin.
Dholuo: Mondo ikony kodhi mag alode mondo kik hinygi kapok ichwoyo, ketgi e pi mochwe e okang' ma ikwayo ni nyaka chop kama ichweye (masalre ni, spinach, chopi, pepper, tomato kod eggplant: 50°C kuom dakika 30; lettuce kod celery: 47°C kuom dakika 30) kae to ilwokgi mapiyo e pi maler kendo turogi kapok ichwoyo kata iketgi e kar kano.

English: When mixing urea into livestock feed, do not exceed 30% of the animal's digestible crude protein requirement from urea, as too much urea can overdose and harm the animal.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuchanganya urea kwenye malisho ya mifugo, usizidi 30% ya mahitaji ya protini ghafi ya mnyama kutoka kwa urea, kwani urea nyingi zinaweza kuzidisha na kumdhuru mnyama.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 47, April 2009 (infonet-biovision.org) - narrow-lexicon "recommendations" hit, previously scanned but not yet converted

Somali: Marka urea lagu daro quudinta xoolaha, ha ka badin 30% baahida borotiinka ceeriin ee xayawaanka ee la dheefshiidi karo ee urea ah, maadaama urea badan ay xad-dhaaf u keeni karto oo ay waxyeello u geysan karto xayawaanka.
Dholuo: Sama iketo urea e chiemb dhok, kik idwokne kuom 30% mar protein ma le dwaro e ring'o nikech ng'injo mang'eny ahinya nyalo miyo ondiek obed marach.

English: To treat fodder tree seeds such as Leucaena using the hot-water method, pour plenty of boiling water over the seeds and stir gently for 2-5 minutes - do not soak too long, as hot water can kill the seeds - then pour off the hot water, replace it with cool water, and let the seeds soak for 12 hours until they swell visibly.
Kiswahili: Ili kutibu mbegu za miti ya lishe kama vile Leucaena kwa kutumia njia ya maji ya moto, mimina maji mengi ya moto juu ya mbegu na koroga kwa upole kwa dakika 2-5 - usiloweke kwa muda mrefu, kwani maji ya moto yanaweza kuua mbegu - kisha mimina maji ya moto, ubadilishe na maji baridi, na uache mbegu ziloweke kwa masaa 12 hadi zivimbe wazionekane.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 73, June 2011 (infonet-biovision.org) - narrow-lexicon "recommendations" hit, previously scanned but not yet converted

Somali: Si aad u daaweyso miraha geedaha quudinta sida Leucaena adoo isticmaalaya habka biyaha kulul, ku shubi biyo badan oo kulayl badan oo ku dul daadinaya miraha oo si tartiib tartiib ah u dhaqdhaqaaqo 2-5 daqiiqo - ha ku qoyaan waqti dheer, maadaama biyo kulul ay dili karaan miraha - ka dibna ku shubi biyo kulul, ku beddelo biyo qabow, oo u oggolow miraha inay qoyaan 12 saacadood ilaa ay si muuqata u dhoofiyaan.
Dholuo: Mondo iti gi pi mang'ich e loso kodhi mag yiende ma loso chiemo kaka Leucaena, ket pi mang'eny ma ng'ich e wi kodhi kendo ilosgi mos kuom dakika 2-5 - kik iket pi mang'eny ahinya nikech pi mang'ich nyalo nego kodhi - kae to ilos pi mang'ich, ilos gi pi mang'ich, kae to iwe kodhi mondo omol kuom seche 12 nyaka chop kama pi mang'ichno bedo marach.

English: Before seasonal planning and planting, ask yourself: What do my soil test results say? Do I understand the recommendations and where I can source the recommended inputs? What inputs do I need to apply? Do I have a crop rotation calendar or plan? Better yields can only be achieved through proper soil management.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kupanga na kupanda msimu, jiulize: Matokeo yangu ya mtihani wa udongo yanasema nini? Je, ninaelewa mapendekezo na wapi ninaweza kupata pembejeo zilizopendekezwa? Je, ni pembejeo gani ninahitaji kuomba? Je, nina kalenda au mpango wa mzunguko wa mazao? Mavuno bora yanaweza kupatikana tu kupitia usimamizi sahihi wa udongo.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 169, August 2019 (infonet-biovision.org) - narrow-lexicon "recommendations" hit, previously scanned but not yet converted

Somali: Kahor qorsheynta xilliyeedka iyo beerista, is weydii: Maxay natiijooyinka tijaabada ciidda sheegayaan? Ma fahamsanahay talooyinka iyo meesha aan ka heli karo xogaha la soo jeediyay? Waa maxay xogaha aan u baahanahay si aan u dabaqo? Ma hayaa jadwal ama qorshe dalagga? Dalag ka wanaagsan waxaa lagu gaari karaa kaliya maareynta saxda ah ee ciidda.
Dholuo: Kapok ichano kod chwoyo yien e kinde mar higa, penjri ane kama: Be awinjoga e wi gik ma asepuonjora e wi lowo? Be ang'eyo paro ma ji chiwo koda kama anyalo yudoe gik ma dwarore? Gin gik mage monego atiyogo? Be an gi chenro mar chwoyo yien?

English: To control Tuta absoluta in tomatoes, begin control measures in the nursery and continue in the field: set out pheromone traps, or basins of water with a suspended attractant, at least one week before transplanting.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Tuta absoluta katika nyanya, kuanza hatua za kudhibiti katika nursery na kuendelea katika uwanja: kuweka mitego pheromone, au basins ya maji na suspended attractant, angalau wiki moja kabla ya transplantation.
Source: Farm Radio International / The Organic Farmer, TOF issue no. 190, May 2021 (infonet-biovision.org) - narrow-lexicon "recommendations" hit, previously scanned but not yet converted

Somali: Si loo xakameeyo Tuta absoluta ee yaanyada, bilow tallaabooyinka xakamaynta ee qolka beerta kadibna sii wad beerta: dhig dabinno pheromone ah, ama barkado biyo ah oo leh soo jiidasho la supendeeyay, ugu yaraan hal toddobaad ka hor beerista.
Dholuo: Mondo ichik Tuta absoluta e tomato, chak timo kamano e ot mar nyithindo kendo idhi nyime e pap: ketie oboke mag pheromone, kata pi ma nigi gimoro ma ywayo pi, kata bed ni en kamano, kata matin, jumbe achiel kapok ichiko.

English: To achieve the optimal planting density for groundnut, sow one seed per hole at an inter-row spacing of 30cm and intra-row spacing of 15cm (or 45cm inter-row and 10cm intra-row for easier weeding); do the first weeding between 20 and 50 days after planting, depending on local weed growth.
Kiswahili: Ili kufikia msongamano bora wa upandaji wa karanga, panda mbegu moja kwa kila shimo kwa nafasi ya kati ya safu ya 30cm na nafasi ya ndani ya safu ya 15cm (au 45cm kati ya safu na 10cm ndani ya safu kwa kupalilia kwa urahisi); Fanya kupalilia kwanza kati ya siku 20 na 50 baada ya kupanda, kulingana na ukuaji wa magugu ya ndani.
Source: Africa RISING / IITA "Optimal spacing for groundnuts in smallholder farming systems" Technology Brief, March 2021, northern Ghana (CC-licensed) (cgspace.cgiar.org item 6e27f615-e5b9-4307-b4ff-2661f52f5c15)

Somali: Si loo gaaro cufnaanta ugu habboon ee beerta lowska, hal abuur ku beer dalool kasta oo leh masaafo u dhexeysa safka 30cm iyo dhexda safka 15cm (ama 45cm dhexda safka iyo 10cm dhexda safka si loo fududeeyo cawska cawska); Ka saar cawska ugu horreeya inta u dhaxaysa 20 ilaa 50 maalmood kadib beerista, iyadoo ku xiran koritaanka cawska deegaanka.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ichop e pek maber mar pidho mtokni, chuo kodhi achiel kuom bur moro ka moro e kind tong' 30 cm kod tong' 15 cm (kata 45 cm e kind tong' kod tong' 10 cm mondo yot chwoyo; chuo kodhi mokwongo timore e kind ndalo 20 kod 50 bang' chwoyo, kaluwore gi kaka lum dongo e alworano.

English: To minimize aflatoxin contamination in groundnut and maize and prevent losses, farmers can apply a biocontrol product called Aflasafe, which cuts aflatoxin levels by 96-100% down to safe levels for consumption, from the moment of harvest all the way through storage until the food is eaten.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza uchafuzi wa aflatoxin katika karanga na mahindi na kuzuia hasara, wakulima wanaweza kutumia bidhaa ya kudhibiti kibaiolojia inayoitwa Aflasafe, ambayo hupunguza viwango vya aflatoxin kwa 96-100% hadi viwango salama kwa matumizi, kutoka wakati wa mavuno hadi kuhifadhi hadi chakula kinakula.
Source: Africa RISING / IITA "Optimal spacing for groundnuts in smallholder farming systems" Technology Brief, March 2021, northern Ghana (CC-licensed) (cgspace.cgiar.org item 6e27f615-e5b9-4307-b4ff-2661f52f5c15)

Somali: Si loo yareeyo wasakheynta aflatoxin ee lowska dhulka iyo galleyda loona hortago khasaaraha, beeraleydu waxay isticmaali karaan badeecad biocontrol ah oo la yiraahdo Aflasafe, taasoo hoos u dhigta heerka aflatoxin 96-100% ilaa heerar ammaan ah oo la cuno, laga bilaabo goosashada ilaa kaydinta ilaa cuntada la cuno.
Dholuo: Mondo omi joma pidho cham okethre gi aflatoxin e lowo kod kod kodhi, kendo kik gikethgi, jopur nyalo tiyo gi yath mar thieth miluongo ni Aflasafe, ma miyo aflatoxin bedo kama ber kuom 96-100% nyaka chop kama cham nyalo betie, chakre kinde ma gichamoe cham nyaka kinde ma gichamoe chiemo.

English: Select a groundnut variety suited to your agro-ecological zone; in Nigeria, the Sahel, Sudan, and Northern and Southern Guinea savanna zones are the main groundnut-growing regions, so choose a variety adapted to your zone's maturity period and market preferences.
Kiswahili: Chagua aina ya karanga inayofaa kwa eneo lako la kilimo-ikolojia; nchini Nigeria, Sahel, Sudan, na maeneo ya savanna ya Kaskazini na Kusini mwa Guinea ndio maeneo makuu ya kukuza karanga, kwa hivyo chagua aina iliyobadilishwa kulingana na kipindi cha ukomavu wa eneo lako na mapendeleo ya soko.
Source: N2Africa "Better groundnut through good agricultural practices" leaflet, For farmers in Nigeria (CC-licensed) - regional variety-selection excerpt, distinct from the shared template text (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/365 N2Africa Nigeria groundnut booklet.pdf)

Somali: Dooro nooc lowska dhulka ah oo ku habboon aaggaaga deegaanka; Nigeria, savannada Sahel, Sudan, iyo Northern iyo Southern Guinea ayaa ah gobollada ugu waaweyn ee lowska lagu beero, sidaas darteed dooro nooc la jaanqaado xilliga bisaylka iyo doorashada suuqa ee aaggaaga.
Dholuo: Yier kit olemo mar goro ma owinjore gi alwora midakie; e piny Nigeria, e alwora mar Sahel, Sudan, kod e alwora mar Northern and Southern Guinea, e ma gipidhoga goro madongo, omiyo yier kit olemo ma owinjore gi kinde ma olemo dongo kod kaka chuech ohero.

English: Select a cowpea variety suited to your agro-ecological zone and cropping system; in Zimbabwe, Natural Regions IV and V (the drier regions) are suitable for growing cowpea, so consider maturity period, drought tolerance, and pest and disease resistance when choosing a variety.
Kiswahili: Chagua aina ya cowpea inayofaa kwa eneo lako la kilimo-ikolojia na mfumo wa mazao; nchini Zimbabwe, Mikoa ya Asili ya IV na V (mikoa kavu zaidi) inafaa kwa kukuza mbaazi, kwa hivyo fikiria kipindi cha ukomavu, uvumilivu wa ukame, na upinzani wa wadudu na magonjwa wakati wa kuchagua aina.
Source: N2Africa "Better cowpea through good agricultural practices" leaflet, For farmers in Zimbabwe (CC-licensed) - regional variety-selection excerpt, distinct from the shared template text (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/290 N2Africa Zimbabwe cowpea booklet.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=extension leaflet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zimbabwe; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.482; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.336; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.025
Somali: Dooro nooc ka mid ah cawska cawska ee ku habboon aaggaaga beeraha iyo nidaamka beerashada; Zimbabwe, Gobollada Dabiiciga ah ee IV iyo V (goobaha qalalan) ayaa ku habboon beerashada cawska, sidaa darteed tixgeli muddada bislaanshaha, dulqaadka abaarta, iyo u adkaysiga cayayaanka iyo cudurrada markaad dooranayso nooc.
Dholuo: Yier kit cham mar cowpea mowinjore gi alwora midakie kod kit pur; e piny Zimbabwe, kuonde ma cham yudoree e alwora mar IV kod V (maboyo) e ma owinjore gi cham mar cowpea, omiyo sama iyiero kit chamno, kaw ane kinde ma cham dongo, kaka yotne bedo gi tuwo, kod kaka onyalo geng'o tuoche kod tuoche.

English: On hillsides, prepare a flat seedbed and control soil erosion, for example with terracing; on flat volcanic soils prone to flooding, prepare ridges about 75cm apart, since ridges help prevent the waterlogging that damages bean plants.
Kiswahili: Kwenye vilima, andaa mbegu za gorofa na udhibiti mmomonyoko wa udongo, kwa mfano na terracing; Kwenye udongo tambarare wa volkeno unaokabiliwa na mafuriko, andaa matuta karibu 75cm mbali, kwani matuta husaidia kuzuia maji ambayo huharibu mimea ya maharagwe.
Source: N2Africa "Better beans through good agricultural practices" leaflet, For farmers in Rwanda (CC-licensed) - hillside/volcanic-soil land preparation excerpt, distinct from the shared template text (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/361 N2Africa Rwanda common beans booklet.pdf)

Somali: Buuraha, diyaari abuur siman oo xakameeya nabaad-guurka ciidda, tusaale ahaan adigoo adeegsanaya terracing; Dhul fidsan oo foolkaano ah oo u nugul fatahaado, diyaari ridges qiyaastii 75cm kala duwan, maadaama ridges ay ka hortagaan biyaha ku qulqulaya oo waxyeello u geysta dhirta digirta.
Dholuo: E wi gode, iket tong' ma bor gi lowo kendo rit piny kik kethre, kuom ranyisi ka itiyo gi lowo ma nigi pi; e lowo ma bor gi lowo ma nigi volkano ma nyalo ywayo pi, iket tong' ma bor gi tong'no romo sentimita 75 nikech tong'no konyo e geng'o pi kik pong' ma ketho yiende mag nyinyo.

English: Farmers are advised to regularly monitor weather updates and follow guidance from agricultural extension officers to support timely decision-making and reduce weather-related risks.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kufuatilia mara kwa mara sasisho za hali ya hewa na kufuata mwongozo kutoka kwa maafisa wa ugani wa kilimo ili kusaidia kufanya maamuzi kwa wakati na kupunguza hatari zinazohusiana na hali ya hewa.

Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay si joogto ah ula socdaan cusbooneysiinta cimilada iyo inay raacaan talooyinka saraakiisha qaybinta beeraha si loo taageero go'aanno waqtigeeda ku habboon loona yareeyo khataraha la xiriira cimilada.
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo onon kinde ka kinde weche mag ndalo kod kaka weche mag ndalo medo bedo manyien kendo giluw kaka jotelo mag weche mag pur chiko mondo omi giti gi kinde mowinjore e kawo paro kendo gimed dwoko chien hinyruok ma bedoe nikech ndalo.

English: To control aphids on beans, check the undersides of leaves on 20-30 plants across the field; if two or three plants have at least two groups of aphids, spray both sides of the leaves with soapy water in the early morning or evening.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti aphids kwenye maharagwe, angalia sehemu za chini za majani kwenye mimea 20-30 kwenye shamba; Ikiwa mimea miwili au mitatu ina angalau vikundi viwili vya aphids, nyunyiza pande zote mbili za majani na maji ya sabuni asubuhi na mapema au jioni.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Soap controls aphids in beans", Created in Kenya, September 2011, CC-licensed (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20117800545.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Kenya; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.974; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.717; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.594
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo aphids-ka digirta, hubi dhinacyada hoose ee caleemaha 20-30 geed oo ku yaal beerta; Haddii laba ama saddex geed ay leeyihiin ugu yaraan laba kooxood oo aphids ah, ku buufi labada dhinac ee caleemaha biyo saabuun ah subaxdii hore ama fiidkii.
Dholuo: Mondo inyal geng'o yadhno kik kethre, non weche manie bwo yiende 20-30 manie puodho; ka yiende ariyo kata adek nigi yadhno, to ler pi mang'ich e kor yiendego gokinyi kata odhiambo.

English: To manage black rot in brassica crops, rotate with non-Brassica plants and avoid replanting Brassica in the same field more than once every 2 years; control weeds around the farm, avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation, and plant only disease-free seeds or seedlings.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti kuoza kwa mimea ya shaba nyeupe, zunguka kwa mimea isiyo yaBrassica na uepuke kupanda tena Brassica katika shamba lilelile zaidi ya mara moja kila baada ya miaka 2, dhibiti magugu kuzunguka shamba, epuka unyunyizaji wa maji ulio juu ya ardhi, na upande mbegu au miche isiyo na maradhi.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Black rot on Brassica", Created in Kenya, December 2012, CC-licensed (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20137804264.pdf)
