Somali: Si loo xakameeyo burburka madow ee dalagga Brassica, la wareejiya dhirta aan Brassica ahayn oo ka fogaada dib u beerista Brassica isla beerta in ka badan 2 sanoba mar; xakameynta cawska agagaarka beerta, ka fogaada waraabinta buufinta sare, oo kaliya ku beeri abuurka ama geedo cudur-free.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato obed gi nyalo mar rito yadh-badhno, nyaka olok gi yiende mamoko maok gin mag Brassica kendo kik ochak odwar Brassica e puodho achielno nyading'eny bang' higni ariyo; onego oti gi yore mopogore opogore mag rito lum e alwora mar puodho, kik oti gi gik ma miyo ji pi, kendo onego odwar kodhi kata chamo kodhi ma onge tuoche.

English: To mass-trap mango fruit flies, cut a plastic bottle in half, fill the lower half with fermented fruit juice, invert the top half as a funnel into it, and hang at least 10 traps per 100 square metres in the lower canopy of mango and guava trees - this only works if farmers in the area do it together.
Kiswahili: Ili kunasa nzi wa matunda ya embe, kata chupa ya plastiki katikati, jaza nusu ya chini na juisi ya matunda iliyochacha, geuza nusu ya juu kama faneli ndani yake, na utundike angalau mitego 10 kwa mita za mraba 100 kwenye dari ya chini ya miti ya embe na mapera - hii inafanya kazi tu ikiwa wakulima katika eneo hilo watafanya pamoja.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Come together to mass trap Mango fruit fly", Created in Tanzania, September 2012, CC-licensed (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20127802225.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Tanzania; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.834; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.404; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.022
Somali: Si aad u qabato duqsiyada miraha mango-ga, dhalo caag ah kala gooy, qaybta hoose ku buuxi casiirka miraha khamiirka ah, badhka sare u rog sida tuulo, ugu yaraan 10 dabinno 100 mitir laba jibbaaran ah geedaha hoose ee geedaha mango iyo guava - tani waxay shaqaysaa oo kaliya haddii beeraleyda deegaanka ay wada sameeyaan.
Dholuo: Mondo ng'ato omak yadh mango, ng'ad piende mag plastik e bathgi ariyo, opong'gi gi pi mar yadh mang'we ng'ich, olorgi gi piende ma nigi suya, kendo ogurgi gi yadh mang'we ng'ich ma malo, kendo ogurgi gi yadh 10 e mita 100 kargi e bwo yiende mag mango kod guava.

English: Wear protective gear (carts, boots, mouth and nose pads, hard hats, goggles, and gloves) to protect against the effects of pesticides.
Kiswahili: Vaa zana za kujikinga (ovaroli, buti, kiziba mdomo na pua, kofia ngumu, miwani na glavu) kwa ajili ya kukukinga dhidi ya athari za viua wadudu. Usitumie viua wadudu vya Daraja la I kulingana na WHO (vyenye alama nyekundu) kwa sababu ni hatari sana; uwe mwangalifu pia na vyenye alama ya njano.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Vidokezo kwa Wakulima" (Tips for Farmers) - "Upuliziaji salama kwa kutumia bomba la kupulizia kiua wadudu" (Safe spraying using a pesticide sprayer), Created in Tanzania, September 2013, CC-licensed, Kiswahili-original (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20147801018.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=sw; country=Tanzania; qa_tool=nllb; qa_roundtrip=0.526; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.865; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.39
Somali: Isku xir qalab difaaca (gaadiidka, kabaha, afka iyo sanka, koofiyadaha adag, muraayadaha, iyo gacmo gacmeedyada) si looga ilaaliyo saameynta cayayaanka.
Dholuo: Rwakri gi gik ma rito ngimani (kar, sanduk, tong' ma ok nyal tiyo gi dhogi, kata dhogi, kata yie wiye, ng'ieng'o, kata lwete) mondo kik ichandi gi tuoche ma nego ng'ato.

English: To prevent mealybug spread in cassava, collect planting cuttings from a known mealybug-free area (not during the dry season), cut off the top and bottom 10-20cm of each stem, then soak the remaining cuttings in hot (not boiling) water for 5 minutes before cooling and planting.
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia kuenea kwa mealybug katika mihogo, kusanya vipandikizi vya kupanda kutoka eneo linalojulikana lisilo na mealybug (sio wakati wa kiangazi), kata juu na chini 10-20cm ya kila shina, kisha loweka vipandikizi vilivyobaki kwenye maji ya moto (sio ya kuchemsha) kwa dakika 5 kabla ya kupoa na kupanda.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Clean cassava cuttings to stop mealybug spread", Created in Tanzania, September 2013, CC-licensed (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20147801029.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Tanzania; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.898; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.422; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.206
Somali: Si looga hortago faafitaanka mealybug-ka ee cassava, ururi godadka beerta meel aan cayayaanka lahayn (ma aha xilliga qalalan), goyn 10-20cm kore iyo hoose ee laan kasta, kadibna ku qoy godadka haray biyo kulul (aan karkarin) 5 daqiiqo ka hor qaboojinta oo beerin.
Dholuo: Mondo kik ng'ato oyud ng'ato gi ng'ato ma nigi ng'ama ok nyal chamo ng'ato, nyaka ochak chamo ng'ato gi ng'ato ma ok onyal chamo ng'ato gi ng'ato.

English: Inspect your maize field often while plants are young; uproot infected plants as soon as they show disease signs and put the whole plant in a sack so leafhoppers do not spread to healthy plants, then plant a resistant maize variety next season.
Kiswahili: Kagua shamba lako la mahindi mara nyingi wakati mimea ni mchanga; Ng'oa mimea iliyoambukizwa mara tu inapoonyesha dalili za magonjwa na kuweka mmea mzima kwenye gunia ili majani yasienee kwa mimea yenye afya, kisha panda aina ya mahindi sugu msimu ujao.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Maize streak virus", Created in Kenya, September 2011, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20117800551.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Kenya; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.724; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.289; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.585
Somali: Marar badan baadh beertaada galleyda inta geedu yar yihiin; Dhirta cudurka qabta ka saar marka ay calaamadaha cudurka muujiyaan, geedka oo dhan ku rid bac si leafhoppers aysan ugu faafin dhirta caafimaad qaba, ka dibna beer nooc galley ah oo adkaysi leh xilliga dambe.
Dholuo: Non puothe mag cham kinde mang'eny ka yienego pod tindo; gol yien ma nigi tuwo ka giseneno ni gikwongo bedo gi tuwo kendo iketgi e sanduk mondo yienego kik landre e yien ma nigi ngima maber, kae to ipidh kit yien ma nigi tuwo e kinde mabiro.

English: To manage Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus, remove and burn diseased plants, plant resistant varieties, intercrop with maize to reduce whitefly access to the crop, and control whiteflies with oil sprays or insecticides while always wearing protective clothing and following the product label.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Virusi vya Majani ya Njano ya Nyanya, ondoa na uchome mimea yenye magonjwa, aina sugu za mimea, kuingiliana na mahindi ili kupunguza upatikanaji wa nzi weupe kwenye mazao, na kudhibiti nzi weupe kwa dawa za kunyunyizia mafuta au dawa za kuua wadudu huku kila wakati ukivaa nguo za kinga na kufuata lebo ya bidhaa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus on Tomato", Created in Kenya, December 2012, CC-licensed (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20137804221.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Kenya; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.036; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.329; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.047
Somali: Si loo maareeyo fayraska Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus, ka saar oo gubo dhirta cudurka leh, noocyada adkeysiga dhirta, isku darka galleyda si loo yareeyo helitaanka shinnida cad ee dalagga, iyo xakameynta shinnida cad adigoo adeegsanaya buufin saliid ama cayayaanka oo mar walba xiran dhar ilaalin ah oo raacaya calaamadda alaabta.
Dholuo: Mondo oti gi tuoche mag Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus, onego ogol kendo owang'e yiende ma nigi tuoche, kod kit yiende ma ok nyal geng'o yiende, kendo onego ogolgi gi cham mar cham mondo omi lumbe mag cham kik donj e cham, kendo onego oti gi thieth mag oil spray kata ndawa makelo tuoche mag kute ka kinde duto girwako lewni ma geng'o kod ka giluwo weche ma ondik e kalatas mar yiendno.

English: During hot weather, protect farm animals from heat stress by providing well-ventilated shelter and plenty of cool drinking water; do not move animals between 10:00am and 4:00pm, the hottest part of the day.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa hali ya hewa ya joto, linda wanyama wa shambani kutokana na mafadhaiko ya joto kwa kutoa makazi yenye hewa ya kutosha na maji mengi baridi ya kunywa; Usihamishe wanyama kati ya 10:00am na 4:00pm, sehemu ya joto zaidi ya siku.
Source: NAERLS (Nigerian Livestock Early Warning System), Climate Factsheet No. 003, 1 May 2024 (naerls.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/N-LEWS-Climate-factsheet-May.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Nigeria; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.99; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.729; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.566
Somali: Xilliga kulul, xayawaanka beerta ka ilaali cadaadiska kulaylka adigoo bixinaya hoy hawo fiican leh iyo biyo qabow oo badan; Ha dhaqaajin xayawaanka inta u dhaxaysa 10:00 subaxnimo ilaa 4:00 galabnimo, qaybta ugu kulul maalinta.
Dholuo: Sama liet ng'ich, rit le mag puodho kik hinyre gi liet kuom chiwo kar dak ma nigi muya maber kendo pi mang'eny ma ng'ich; kik iling le e kind sa apar okinyi nyaka sa auchiel odhiambo, ma en kinde ma liet ahinya e odiechieng'.

English: Feed poultry and swine during the cooler hours of early morning and late evening, and cool large livestock such as cattle, sheep, goats, and pigs by misting them with water or letting them wallow in shallow water.
Kiswahili: Lisha kuku na nguruwe wakati wa baridi asubuhi na mapema jioni, na upoze mifugo mikubwa kama vile ng'ombe, kondoo, mbuzi na nguruwe kwa kuwanyunyiza maji au kuwaacha waingie kwenye maji ya kina kifupi.
Source: NAERLS (Nigerian Livestock Early Warning System), Climate Factsheet No. 003, 1 May 2024 (naerls.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/N-LEWS-Climate-factsheet-May.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Nigeria; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.79; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.326; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.621
Somali: Hagaajinta digaagga iyo doofaarka saacadaha qabow ee subaxdii hore iyo fiidkii dambe, iyo xoolaha waaweyn sida lo'da, idaha, riyaha iyo doofaarka qaboojinta iyaga oo biyo ku qasiyay ama u oggolaanaya inay ku dhuumaalaan biyaha hooseeya.
Dholuo: Chiemuru le kod anguru e seche mag koyo mang'ich ahinya, ka okinyi kod odhiambo, kendo rituru jamni madongo kaka dhok, rombe, diek, kod anguru ka umogi gi pi kata ka uwegi mondo gipodhi e pi matin.

English: In fish farms, manage high water temperatures by exchanging at least 10-20% of pond water daily with cooler water, aerating the water, maintaining pond depth of at least 1-1.5m, shading ponds from direct sun, and reducing fish stocking density during hot weather.
Kiswahili: Katika mashamba ya samaki, dhibiti halijoto ya juu ya maji kwa kubadilishana angalau 10-20% ya maji ya bwawa kila siku na maji baridi, kuingiza maji, kudumisha kina cha bwawa cha angalau 1-1.5m, mabwawa ya kivuli kutoka kwa jua moja kwa moja, na kupunguza msongamano wa samaki wakati wa hali ya hewa ya joto.
Source: NAERLS (Nigerian Livestock Early Warning System), Climate Factsheet No. 003, 1 May 2024 (naerls.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/N-LEWS-Climate-factsheet-May.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Nigeria; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.472; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.464; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.41
Somali: Beeraha kalluunka, maareynta heerkulka sare ee biyaha adoo maalin kasta ugu yaraan 10-20% biyo ka beddelaya biyo qabow, hawo-mareynta biyaha, ilaalinta qoto dheer ee ugu yaraan 1-1.5m, hoos u dhigida kuwa ka soo baxa qorraxda tooska ah, iyo yareynta cufnaanta kalluunka inta lagu jiro cimilada kulul.
Dholuo: E puothe ma ji pidhoe rech, rituru liet mar pi ma malo kuom loko chakre pasent 10 nyaka 20 mar pi pi mar yawo pile ka pile gi pi mang'ich, rieyo pi, rito matut mar pi mar pwodhruok ma ok tin ne 1-1.5m, keto pi mar pi e bwo wang' chieng', kendo miyo rech obed mang'eny e seche mag liet.

English: Livestock farmers and feed millers across Nigeria can lower input costs by planting maize, sorghum, groundnuts, and cowpeas at the start of the rainy season to use as animal feed and feed ingredients.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa mashambani na walisha waendeshaji wa vinu kotekote Naijeria waweza kupunguza gharama kwa kupanda mahindi, maharagwe ya soya, udongo wa chini, na ng'ombe mwanzoni mwa msimu wa mvua ili kutumia kama chakula cha wanyama na chakula.
Source: NAERLS (Nigerian Livestock Early Warning System), Climate Factsheet No. 004, 5 June 2024 (naerls.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/N-LEWS-Climate-factsheet-June.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Nigeria; qa_tool=opus; qa_roundtrip=0.765; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.38; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.551
Somali: Beeraleyda xoolaha iyo warshadaha quudinta ee Nigeria guud ahaan waxay hoos u dhigi karaan kharashka gelinta iyagoo beeraya galley, sorghum, lows, iyo lo' digir bilowga xilliga roobka si loogu isticmaalo quudinta xoolaha iyo maaddada.
Dholuo: Jo-pidh dhok kod joma loso chiemo e piny Nigeria nyalo dwoko chien nengo mag chiemo ka gipidho cham, sorghum, goro, kod mag dhok e chak higa mar koth mondo gitigo kaka chiemo kod gik ma ginyalo pidho le.

English: To prevent Fall Armyworm infestation, use high-quality, disease-free seed, avoid late or staggered planting, and increase plant diversity in your plots (for example intercropping) to make maize less attractive to armyworm moths.
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia uvamizi wa minyoo ya Fall Armyworm, tumia mbegu za hali ya juu, zisizo na magonjwa, epuka kupanda kwa kuchelewa au kwa kuyumba, na uongeze utofauti wa mimea katika mashamba yako (kwa mfano kilimo kiingiliano) ili kufanya mahindi yasivutie nondo za jeshi.
Source: FAO, "How to Manage Fall Armyworm: A Quick Guide for Smallholders" (FAW Guidance Note 4), CA0435EN/1/07.18 (openknowledge.fao.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/359d03ae-27c3-4257-a906-a4e155c2a2b1/content)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=FAO technical guidance note; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.63; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.523; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.047
Somali: Si looga hortago cayayaanka Fall Armyworm, isticmaal abuurka tayada sare leh, cudur-free, ka fogow beerashada gaabis ah ama la kala go'ay, iyo kordhinta kala duwanaanta dhirta ee dhulkaaga (tusaale ahaan beeraha isku dhafan) si ay u sameeyaan hadhuudh ka yar soo jiidasho leh u armyworm moots.
Dholuo: Mondo kik cham cham ma ok nyal chango, ti gi kodhi ma nigi ber kendo ma onge tuoche, kik ipidh cham ma ok imedo kata ma ok imedo chwoyo, kendo meduru pidho yien mopogore opogore e puotheu (e ranyisi, ka ipidhgi e kind yien) mondo cham ma cham ok bed maber ne le mag cham.

English: Starting one week after planting, walk through your maize field every 3-4 days to check plant health and look for Fall Armyworm egg masses, young larvae, and leaf damage, so problems can be caught and treated early.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia wiki moja baada ya kupanda, tembea kwenye shamba lako la mahindi kila baada ya siku 3-4 ili kuangalia afya ya mmea na utafute wingi wa mayai ya Fall Armyworm, mabuu machanga, na uharibifu wa majani, ili matatizo yaweze kukamatwa na kutibiwa mapema.
Source: FAO, "How to Manage Fall Armyworm: A Quick Guide for Smallholders" (FAW Guidance Note 4), CA0435EN/1/07.18 (openknowledge.fao.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/359d03ae-27c3-4257-a906-a4e155c2a2b1/content)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=FAO technical guidance note; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.743; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.594; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.157
Somali: Laga bilaabo hal usbuuc ka dib beerashada, 3-4 maalmoodba mar ka dhex socod beertaada hadhuudhka si aad u hubiso caafimaadka dhirta oo aad u raadiso mugga ukumaha Fall Armyworm, dhallaanka dhalinyarada ah, iyo dhaawaca caleemaha, si dhibaatooyinka loo qabto loona daaweeyo waqti hore.
Dholuo: Chakre juma achiel bang' pidho puodho, wuoth e puotheu mar kodhi bang' ndalo 3-4 mondo ine kaka yienego chalo kendo mondo ine kaka tong' mag tong' mag jolweny mag piny, nyithi kod yiende ma ne oneg, mondo omi ichak ine kendo itiek chandruogego chon.

English: Control Fall Armyworm by crushing egg masses and picking off young larvae by hand before they enter the maize whorl; avoid unnecessary chemical pesticide use, which is costly and can kill the natural predators that help control the pest.
Kiswahili: Dhibiti Fall Armyworm kwa kuponda wingi wa mayai na kuokota mabuu wachanga kwa mkono kabla ya kuingia kwenye whorl ya mahindi; Epuka matumizi ya dawa ya kemikali isiyo ya lazima, ambayo ni ya gharama kubwa na inaweza kuua wanyama wanaowinda wanyama wengine ambao husaidia kudhibiti wadudu.
Source: FAO, "How to Manage Fall Armyworm: A Quick Guide for Smallholders" (FAW Guidance Note 4), CA0435EN/1/07.18 (openknowledge.fao.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/359d03ae-27c3-4257-a906-a4e155c2a2b1/content)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=FAO technical guidance note; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.474; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.377; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.02
Somali: Xakamaynta Fall Armyworm adigoo burburinaya qanjirka ukumaha iyo gacanta ku soo qaadaya dhallaanka dhalinyarada ah ka hor inta aysan gelin qanjirka hadhuudhka; ka fogow isticmaalka cayayaanka kiimikada aan loo baahnayn, taas oo qaali ah waxayna dili kartaa cunsurayaasha dabiiciga ah ee ka caawiya xakamaynta cayayaanka.
Dholuo: Rituru lum mar jolweny ma ne dhi chungo tong'go kuom chwoyo tong' mag tong'go kendo golo gige yien matindo e lwetgi kapok gidonjo e puodho mar cham; kik uti gi gik ma ok ochuno kaka yedhe makelo tuoche makelo tuoche, nikech mano en gima tek kendo nyalo nego le ma chando le ma ne nyalo konyo e geng'o tuoche ma ne chando ji.

English: To manage tomato wilt (kiwotoka), rotate tomatoes with maize, beans, or sweet potatoes for several years, plant tomatoes in a different plot each year, try different varieties to find resistant ones, and pull up and burn any wilting plant you find.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti mnyauko wa nyanya (kiwotoka), zungusha nyanya na mahindi, maharagwe, au viazi vitamu kwa miaka kadhaa, panda nyanya katika shamba tofauti kila mwaka, jaribu aina tofauti ili kupata sugu, na uvute na uchome mmea wowote unaonyauka unaopata.
Source: CABI Plantwise, "Tomato wilt or kiwotoka" Factsheet for Farmers, Created in Uganda, July 2006 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20103326447.pdf), CC-BY-SA 4.0
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Uganda; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.45; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.47; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.028
Somali: Si aad u maareysid daadka (kiwotoka), ku wareejiya yaanyada hadhuudhka, xajmiga, ama baradho macaan dhowr sano, ku beeri yaanyada dhul kala duwan sanad kasta, isku day noocyo kala duwan si aad u hesho kuwa u adkaysta, iyo soo qaado oo gubanaya dhirta kasta oo daadka ah aad ka hesho.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato obed gi nyalo mar geng'o koth pomade (kiwotoka), nyaka ochak chwoyo pomade gi kodhi, nyinyo, kata kit pomade mamit kuom higni mang'eny, kendo pidhe e puothe mopogore opogore higa ka higa, tem kit pomade mopogore opogore mondo iyud moko ma nyalo geng'o kodhino, kendo igolie kendo wang'o yien moro amora ma omako.

English: To control tomato red spider mite, avoid continuous tomato cropping, remove and destroy crop residues before replanting, wash and sun-dry stakes and twine before reuse, inspect crop borders regularly, and spray water on plants to reduce the dust that mites thrive in.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti utitiri wa buibui nyekundu wa nyanya, epuka kupanda nyanya kuendelea, ondoa na uharibu mabaki ya mazao kabla ya kupanda tena, osha na kausha vigingi na kamba kabla ya kutumia tena, kagua mipaka ya mazao mara kwa mara, na nyunyiza maji kwenye mimea ili kupunguza vumbi ambalo utitiri hustawi.
Source: CABI Plantwise, "Tomato red spider mite" Factsheet for Farmers, Created in Kenya, October 2012 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20137804187.pdf), CC-BY-SA 4.0
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Kenya; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.648; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.319; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.039
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo cayayaanka cas ee yaanyada, ka fogow goynta joogtada ah ee yaanyada, ka saar oo baabi'i wixii dalagga ka hor inta aan dib loo beerin, ku dhaq oo qalaj qorraxda ka hor inta aan dib loo isticmaalin, si joogto ah u eeg xuduudaha dalagga, oo biyo ku buufi dhirta si loo yareeyo boodhka ay ku nool yihiin canka.
Dholuo: Mondo omi kik ng'ato chamo cham mag tomato, nyaka oketh kodhi ma ok dhi nyime, nyaka ogol kodhi modong' kapok opidhogi kendo, nyaka olwok kendo otiek yiende kod yiende kapok oti kodgi kendo, onego onon tong' mag yiende kinde ka kinde, kendo onego opong' yiende gi pi mondo omi oketh buru ma yiende dongoe.

English: To manage potato bacterial wilt, uproot and remove infected plants from the field, buy certified disease-free seed potatoes, rotate potatoes/tomatoes/peppers/eggplants with maize, bananas, beans, cassava, or millet, remove all volunteer potato tubers after harvest, and keep field tools clean.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti mnyauko wa bakteria ya viazi, kung'oa na kuondoa mimea iliyoambukizwa shambani, nunua viazi vya mbegu vilivyoidhinishwa visivyo na magonjwa, zungusha viazi/nyanya/pilipili/biringanya na mahindi, ndizi, maharagwe, mihogo, au mtama, ondoa mizizi yote ya viazi ya kujitolea baada ya kuvuna, na kuweka zana za shambani safi.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Potato bacteria wilt", Created in Rwanda, May 2012, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20127801777.pdf)

Somali: Si loo maareeyo bakteeriyada baradho ee baradho, la baabi'iyo iyo in laga saaro dhirta cudurka ku dhacay beerta, iibso baradho abuurka oo la caddeeyay inay ka xor yihiin cudurrada, baradho / yaanyada / qumbaha / ukumaha ku wareejiya hadhuudh, basasha, hariimada, cassava, ama miir, ka saar dhammaan baradho baradho ah ka dib goosashada, iyo qalabka beerta nadiif ah.
Dholuo: Mondo omi oting'o yien mag yien ma nigi tuwoche mag adundo, ogol oko kendo ogol oko yien ma nigi tuwono, ng'iew yien ma onge tuoche, ket yien mag adundo/tomato/pepper/yath kod kod kodhi, diemo, choko kodhi, kod kodhi, kendo golo yien mag adundo duto bang' keyo, kendo rito gige tich mag puodho obed maler.

English: To reduce Brown Leaf Spot in cassava, use good, healthy planting stock, destroy infected crop husks after harvest, and plant early so the crop grows vigorously; if healthy planting material isn't available, dip cassava stems in a diluted fungicide before planting.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza jani la Brown katika muhogo, tumia mbegu nzuri za kupanda, uharibu maganda ya mazao yaliyoambukizwa baada ya mavuno, na uote mapema ili mmea ukue kwa nguvu; ikiwa vifaa vyenye afya havipatikani, chovya mashina ya muhogo katika kuvu iliyotiwa chumvi kabla ya kupanda.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Brown Leaf Spot (BLS) of Cassava", Created in Uganda, August 2012, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20137804388.pdf)

Somali: Si loo yareeyo Brown Leaf Spot ee cassava, isticmaal beero caafimaad qaba oo wanaagsan, burburi qolofyada dalagga cudurka ka dib goosashada, oo beerta hore si dalaggu si xooggan u koro; Haddii walxaha beerta caafimaadka leh aysan la heli karin, ku qubi laamaha cassava fungicide la khufiyay ka hor inta aan la beerin.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato odwok chien kama oting'o Brown Leaf Spot e manias, onego oti gi yien mabeyo kendo ma nigi teko mar pidho, onego oketh tong' mag yien ma nigi tuoche bang' keyo, kendo onego ogolgi chon mondo cham odongi maber; ka ok yud gik ma nyalo konyo e pidho manias, onego omwodhgi e yath ma ok nyal thiedhore kapok ogolgi.

English: To free cassava cuttings of mealybugs before planting, heat water until it is too hot to hold a finger in for more than five seconds (about 60C), then dip the cuttings in this hot water for one minute only - do not soak longer, as this can kill the cuttings too.
Kiswahili: Ili kuachilia vipandikizi vya mihogo ya mealybugs kabla ya kupanda, joto maji hadi iwe moto sana kushikilia kidole kwa zaidi ya sekunde tano (karibu 60C), kisha chovya vipandikizi kwenye maji haya ya moto kwa dakika moja tu - usiloweke kwa muda mrefu, kwani hii inaweza kuua vipandikizi pia.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Warm water treatment of cassava mealybug", Created in Zambia, August 2013, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20147801347.pdf)

Somali: Si aad u sii dayso goosashada cassava ee beeraha ka hor intaadan beerin, biyo ku kululeeya ilaa ay aad u kulul tahay in aad faraha ku haysato in ka badan shan ilbiriqsi (qiyaastii 60 C), ka dibna goosashada biyo kulul ku qooyso hal daqiiqo oo keliya - ha sii qooyina, maxaa yeelay tani waxay sidoo kale dilaan kartaa goosashada.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato ogol tong' mag ng'owo kapok ochwoyo, nyaka oyang' pi mochwe ahinya ma ok onyal mako lith lwete kuom dakika mokalo abich (karomo 60oC), kae to omwodh tong'go e pi ma lietno mana kuom dakika achiel kende - kik omed pi, nimar mano nyalo nego tong'go bende.

English: To control cassava mosaic disease, check plants weekly for the first 2-3 months after planting; when you find diseased plants, uproot them by hand once a week, replace them immediately with healthy cuttings, and burn the uprooted diseased plants after sun-drying them away from the field.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa mosaic ya muhogo, angalia mimea kila wiki kwa miezi 2-3 ya kwanza baada ya kupanda; Unapopata mimea yenye ugonjwa, ing'oa kwa mkono mara moja kwa wiki, ubadilishe mara moja na vipandikizi vyenye afya, na uchome mimea iliyong'olewa baada ya kukausha jua mbali na shamba.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Control of cassava mosaic disease by uprooting", Created in Tanzania, October 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800492.pdf)

Somali: Si aad u xakameyso cudurka cassava mosaic, hubi dhirta toddobaadkii inta ugu horreysa 2-3 bilood ka dib markaad beertid; markaad hesho dhirta buka, gacmaha ku qodbo toddobaadkii hal mar, isla markiiba ku beddelo goosashada caafimaad leh, oo ku gub dhirta buka ee qodbo ka dib qorraxda ka qodista iyaga ka baxsan beerta.
Dholuo: Mondo ikwed tuo mar manias mosaic, nonuru yien juma ka juma kuom dweche ariyo kata adek mokwongo bang' pidho; ka uyudo yien ma nigi tuoche, ting'gi oko gi lwete dichiel e juma, ketgi kargi gi yien ma nigi tuoche, kendo wang'gi ka chieng' osepwodhgi oko.

English: To trap snails away from your vegetables, place piles of fresh pawpaw leaves or cassava peels (about the size of a football) near your plots in the evening, about half a metre to a metre from the plants; collect and destroy the snails gathered on the traps early the next morning.
Kiswahili: Ili kunasa konokono mbali na mboga zako, weka marundo ya majani safi ya pawpaw au maganda ya mihogo (karibu saizi ya mpira wa miguu) karibu na viwanja vyako jioni, karibu nusu mita hadi mita kutoka kwa mimea; kukusanya na kuharibu konokono waliokusanyika kwenye mitego mapema asubuhi iliyofuata.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Pawpaw leaves and cassava peels to trap snails", Created in Zambia, December 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800153.pdf)

Somali: Si aad u qabsato qaboojiyaha ka fog khudaartaada, ku rid xidhmooyinka caleemaha cusub ee pawpaw ama qolofka cassava (oo qiyaastii u weyn kubada cagta) agagaarka dhulkaaga fiidkii, qiyaastii nus mitir ilaa mitir ka fog dhirta; soo uruuri oo baabi'i qaboojiyaha laga soo ururiyay dabinada subaxdii dambe.
Dholuo: Mondo iket tong' mabor gi cham, ket tong' mag yien manyien mag pawpaw kata tong' mag manias (ma dirom fut) machiegni gi puothego godhiambo, kama borne romo mita achiel gi nus; kendo chok kendo iketh tong' ma ichoko e tong'go gokinyi mang'ich.

English: To manage mango bacterial black spot, plant tolerant varieties such as Heidi or Sensation, plant windbreaks to reduce rain splash, burn infected fruits and dead branches, prune to improve airflow and light in the canopy, and apply copper sprays or fungicides regularly.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti doa nyeusi la bakteria ya embe, panda aina zinazostahimili kama vile Heidi au Sensation, panda vizuizi vya upepo ili kupunguza mvua, kuchoma matunda yaliyoambukizwa na matawi yaliyokufa, kupogoa ili kuboresha mtiririko wa hewa na mwanga kwenye dari, na kupaka dawa za shaba au fungicides mara kwa mara.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Mango Bacterial Black Spot", Created in Uganda, August 2012, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20137804392.pdf)

Somali: Si loo maareeyo barta madow ee bakteeriyada mango, noocyada u dulqaadata dhirta sida Heidi ama Sensation, si loo yareeyo dabaylaha dhirta si loo yareeyo roobka, gubista miraha cudurka leh iyo laamaha dhintay, jarjar si loo hagaajiyo socodka hawada iyo iftiinka saqafka, iyo isticmaal buufin copper ama fungicides si joogto ah.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato obed gi kido mar mango, onego otim nonro kuom kit yien ma ok nyal yie gi kit yien ma chalo gi Heidi kata Sensation, omed timo yien ma ok nyal yie gi pi, mondo omi koth kik chwer, owang'o olemo kod bede motho ma nigi tuwo, omed timo nonro mondo omi yamo omed rieny kendo ler obedie e kor yien, kendo onego oti gi yedhe ma konyo chwoyo kod mag thieth mag ng'owo e yo mapile.

English: When using legume seed inoculant: use the correct inoculant for each legume species and check the expiration date; protect it from sun and heat, storing between 4-26C; and keep it in tightly closed bags, removing it only with clean utensils.
Kiswahili: Unapotumia chanjo ya mbegu za mikunde: tumia chanjo ifaayo kwa kila aina ya mikunde na angalia muda wa kuharibika; kinga chanjo kutoka kwa jua na joto, ihifadhi kwa joto la 4-26C; na iweke kwenye mkoba uliofungwa kikamilifu, ukiondoa kwa chombo kisafi tu.
Source: N2Africa, "Biological Nitrogen Fixation and Grain Legume Enterprise: Guidelines for N2Africa Master Farmers" (CIAT-TSBF/FORMAT, 2010) - English (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Master%20farmer%20guidelines_BNF%20-%20GL%20enterprise%20s_0.pdf) + Kiswahili edition (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Master%20farmer%20guidelines_BNF-GL_Kiswahili%20version%20incl%20cover-S_0.pdf), "Utumizi bora wa chanjo cha mikunde" checklist

Somali: Marka la isticmaalayo inoculant-ka abuurka digirta: isticmaal inoculant-ka saxda ah ee nooc kasta oo digirta ah oo hubi taariikhda dhicidda; ilaalinaya qorraxda iyo kulaylka, iyadoo kaydinaysa inta u dhaxaysa 4-26C; oo ku hay baco si adag loo xiray, oo kaliya ka saar qalabka nadiifka ah.
Dholuo: Sama itiyo gi yath mar inoculant mar kodhi mag legume: ti gi yath mar inoculant mowinjore ne kit legume ka kitego kendo ne tarik ma gitiyogo otieko; ritogi kuom chieng' kod liet, ka girito e kind 4-26C; kendo ketgi e bags moket e dhogi, ka gigologi mana gi agulni maler.

English: When inoculating legume seeds: use a sticker such as gum arabic to bind the inoculant to the seed (smaller seeds need more sticker), use no less than 10g of inoculant per kg of seed, and inoculate just before planting, covering the seed with soil soon after to protect it from sun and drying.
Kiswahili: Unapochanja mbegu za mikunde: tumia gamu kama Gum Arabic kushikisha chanjo kwenye mbegu (mbegu ndogo huitaji gamu nyingi), tumia chanjo isiyopungua gramu 10 kwa kilo ya mbegu, na chanja mbegu kabla tu ya kupanda, ukizifunika mchangani mara tu baada ya kupanda kuzikinga na jua na kukauka.
Source: N2Africa, "Biological Nitrogen Fixation and Grain Legume Enterprise: Guidelines for N2Africa Master Farmers" (CIAT-TSBF/FORMAT, 2010) - English (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Master%20farmer%20guidelines_BNF%20-%20GL%20enterprise%20s_0.pdf) + Kiswahili edition (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Master%20farmer%20guidelines_BNF-GL_Kiswahili%20version%20incl%20cover-S_0.pdf), "Utumizi bora wa chanjo cha mikunde" checklist

Somali: Markaad ku tallaalayso miraha xashiishka: isticmaal qalab lagu dhejiyo sida cawska carabiga si aad u xidhto xashiishka miraha (siirrada yaryar waxay u baahan yihiin xashiishad badan), isticmaal ugu yaraan 10 g oo xashiishad ah halkii kg oo abuurka ah, oo ku tallaalay ka hor intaadan beerin, oo ku daboolaya abuurka ciidda dhawaan kadib si looga ilaaliyo qorraxda iyo qalajinta.
Dholuo: Sama ichiwo kodhi mag legume: ti gi sticker kaka gum arabic mondo omak kodhi mar legano (kodhi matindo dwarore ni omak kodhi mang'eny), ti gi inoculant ma ok tin ne 10 g e kilo moro mar kodhi, kendo ichiw inokul kapok ichwoyo kodhi, kendo ikop kodhi gi lowo mapiyo bang'e mondo omi kik chieng' rieny kendo kik ochwe.

English: When harvesting and drying groundnuts, do not harvest in the rain or pile the pods into heaps that stay damp, since this encourages mould and dangerous aflatoxin contamination; handle pods carefully to avoid splitting the seeds, which lowers their sale value.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuvuna na kukausha karanga, usivune kwenye mvua au kurundika maganda kwenye lundo ambalo hukaa unyevunyevu, kwani hii inahimiza ukungu na uchafuzi hatari wa aflatoxin; Shughulikia maganda kwa uangalifu ili kuepuka kugawanya mbegu, ambayo hupunguza thamani yao ya mauzo.
Source: N2Africa Outreach Project, "Grain Legume Processing Handbook: Value Addition to Bean, Cowpea, Groundnut and Soybean by Small-Scale African Farmers" (Woomer et al.) (n2africa.org/sites/default/files/Handbook%20Grain%20Legume%20Processing%20S_0.pdf)

Somali: Marka la goosto oo la qalajiyo lowska dhulka, ha goosan roobka ama ha isku ururin qolofka qoyan, maadaama tani ay dhiirrigelinayso caaryada iyo wasakheynta halista ah ee aflatoxin; Si taxaddar leh u maareeya qaybaha si aan abuurka u kala go'in, taasoo hoos u dhigaysa qiimaha iibka.
Dholuo: Sama ichoko kod tugo cham, kik ichok cham e koth kata kik iketgi e bunde ma ok rum nikech mano miyo ichido kod gik ma kelo hinyruok e dendgi.

English: As part of Zambia's national drought response, farming households in affected areas are being provided with seeds and planting materials for early-maturing, drought-resistant crops (including vegetables, maize, mixed beans, and cowpeas), and encouraged to diversify crops to reduce reliance on staples and improve dietary diversity.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya mwitikio wa ukame wa kitaifa wa Zambia, kaya za wakulima katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa zinapewa mbegu na vifaa vya kupanda kwa mazao yanayokomaa mapema, yanayostahimili ukame (pamoja na mboga, mahindi, maharagwe mchanganyiko, na mbaazi), na kuhimizwa kubadilisha mazao ili kupunguza utegemezi wa chakula kikuu na kuboresha utofauti wa lishe.
Source: Zambia Drought Response Appeal (May-December 2024), Agriculture sector response strategy, co-led by WFP/FAO with the Zambian government's DMMU-coordinated national drought response (unocha.org/attachments/9890d85b-000f-4eb3-81cf-7e0984a452ea/Zambia%20Drought%20Response%20Appeal%20_06052024%20FINAL%20V2.pdf)

Somali: Qayb ka mid ah jawaabta abaaraha qaran ee Zambia, qoysaska beeralayda ee meelaha ay saameysay waxaa la siiyaa abuur iyo agab beereed si ay u helaan dalagyada hore ee u adkeysan abaaraha (oo ay ku jiraan khudradda, galleyda, digirta isku dhafan, iyo digirta), waxaana lagu dhiirrigelinayaa in la kala duwanaado dalagyada si loo yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta cuntooyinka muhiimka ah loona hagaajiyo kala duwanaanshaha cunto.
Dholuo: E bwo chandruok mar oro mar piny Zambia, ji mang'eny ma pidho puothe e alwora ma ohinyore yudoga kodhi kod gik ma ginyalo pidho mondo giti gi cham ma ok nyal chwoyo piyo (moriwo gi alot, kod cham, kod cham ma ok nyal chwoyo), kendo ijiwo ji mondo oti gi le mopogore opogore mondo omi giduok chien kaka gik ma gipidho e chiemo kendo gimed bedo gi chiemo mopogore opogore.

English: As part of Zambia's national drought response, affected agro-pastoral communities are receiving livestock disease surveillance and management support, supplementary animal feed, and rehabilitated dams, boreholes, and weirs to secure water access for irrigation and livestock.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya kukabiliana na ukame wa taifa nchini Zambia, jamii za kilimo na malisho zilizoathiriwa zinapata msaada wa ufuatiliaji na usimamizi wa magonjwa ya mifugo, chakula cha ziada cha wanyama, na madaraja yaliyosafishwa, mashimo, na vibanda vya maji ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa maji kwa ajili ya umwagiliaji na mifugo.
Source: Zambia Drought Response Appeal (May-December 2024), Agriculture sector response strategy, co-led by WFP/FAO with the Zambian government's DMMU-coordinated national drought response (unocha.org/attachments/9890d85b-000f-4eb3-81cf-7e0984a452ea/Zambia%20Drought%20Response%20Appeal%20_06052024%20FINAL%20V2.pdf)

Somali: Qayb ka mid ah jawaabta abaaraha qaran ee Zambia, bulshooyinka agro-xoolo-dhaqato ee saameysay ayaa helaya taageero la socodka iyo maareynta cudurrada xoolaha, quudinta xayawaanka oo dheeraad ah, iyo biyo-xireenno dib loo hagaajiyay si loo hubiyo helitaanka biyaha ee waraabka iyo xoolaha.
Dholuo: E bwo chandruok mar kech e piny Zambia, joma odak e alwora ma ji ohero tiyogo e rito kod rito jowadgi, yudo kony mar rito jowadgi, chiwo chiembgi ne jowadgi, kendo loso kuonde ma ji nyalo yudogo pi, kuonde ma ji nyalo yudogo pi, kod kuonde ma ji nyalo yudogo pi.

English: When practicing companion planting, choose crops carefully: for example, intercrop maize with legumes since beans fix nitrogen that maize needs, but avoid pairing two 'heavy feeder' crops like maize and sunflower that compete heavily for the same nutrients.
Kiswahili: Unapofanya kilimo mseto, chagua mazao kwa uangalifu: kwa mfano, changanya mahindi na mikunde kwani maharagwe huweka naitrojeni ambayo mahindi huhitaji, lakini epuka kuchanganya mazao mawili 'yanayohitaji virutubisho vingi' kama mahindi na alizeti ambayo hushindania virutubisho sawa.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Backgrounder: Benefits of crop companion planting and mutualism" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-benefits-crop-companion-planting-mutualism/, Swahili: scripts.farmradio.fm/sw/mwongozo-wa-redio/taarifa-za-awali-faida-za-upandaji-wa-mazao-mbalimbali-kwa-njia-ya-mseto/)

Somali: Markaad ku tababaranayso beerista saaxiibtinimada, si taxaddar leh u dooro dalagyada: tusaale ahaan, isku darka galleyda iyo digirta digirta maadaama digirta ay hagaajiso nitrogen-ka galleyda loo baahan yahay, laakiin ka fogow inaad isku darto laba dalag oo 'culeysi culus' sida galley iyo ubax qorraxeed oo si weyn ugu tartamaya nafatada isku midka ah.
Dholuo: Sama itimo tij pidho kodhi, yier maber: kuom ranyisi, ket kodhi gi cham mag goro nikech chamgo chano nitrojeni ma kodhi dwaro, to kik iket kodhi ariyo ma nigi chiemo ma pek kaka kodhi gi sunflower ma piem ahinya kuom gik ma kelone chiemo.

English: To maintain healthy soil in conservation agriculture, cover at least 30% of your land with crop residues or cover crops; this reduces weeds, prevents erosion of fertile topsoil, and conserves soil moisture, especially in dry regions. Leguminous cover crops like mucuna, sun hemp, and lablab beans can also cut chemical fertilizer use by 60-80% without lowering yields.
Kiswahili: Ili kutunza udongo vizuri katika kilimo hifadhi, funika angalau asilimia 30 ya shamba lako kwa mabaki ya mazao au mazao funika; hii hupunguza magugu, huzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo wenye rutuba, na kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo, hasa katika maeneo yenye ukame. Mazao funika ya jamii ya mikunde kama mukuna, sunhemp, na lablab pia yanaweza kupunguza matumizi ya mbolea za kemikali kwa asilimia 60-80 bila kupunguza mavuno.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Backgrounder: Using permanent soil cover in conservation agriculture" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-using-permanent-soil-cover-conservation-agriculture/, Swahili: scripts.farmradio.fm/sw/mwongozo-wa-redio/utangulizi-utumiaji-wa-mazao-funika-kwenye-kilimo-hifadhi/)

Somali: Si aad u ilaaliso ciid caafimaad qaba ee beeraha ilaalinta, ugu yaraan 30% dhulkaaga ku dabool hadhaaga dalagga ama dalagyada daboolaya; Tani waxay yareysaa cawska, waxay ka hortagtaa nabaadaad-guurka ciidda bacrin ah, waxayna ilaalisaa qoyaanka ciidda, gaar ahaan meelaha qalalan. Dalagyada digirta sida mucuna, sun hemp, iyo digirta lablab ayaa sidoo kale yareyn kara isticmaalka bacriminta kiimikada 60-80% iyada oo aan hoos u dhigin wax-soo-saarka.
Dholuo: Mondo omi lowo obed maber e tij pur, onego ipidh 30% mar lowo mari gi yiende modong' kata yiende modong'. mano miyo ogolo bedo matin, geng'o lowo ma nigi lowo maber, kendo rito lowo obed maler, to ahinya ahinya kuonde ma lowo otwo. Yiende ma nigi suya mamit kaka mucuna, sun hemp, kod lablab beans bende nyalo miyo yiende mag kembe odog chien gi nus kata nus mar piero auchiel maok ochuno ni cham odog chien.

English: To dry rice seed without spoiling it, build a simple raised table from wood or bamboo instead of drying on the ground; air moves freely under the seed so it dries faster and stays clean, and the table can be quickly carried indoors when it rains.
Kiswahili: Ili kukausha mbegu ya mchele bila kuiharibu, jenga meza iliyoinuliwa kutoka kwa mbao au mianzi badala ya kukaushwa ardhini; hewa husonga kwa uhuru chini ya mbegu hiyo ili iwe kavu zaidi na kubaki ikiwa safi, na meza yaweza kubebwa upesi ndani ya nyumba inaponyesha.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Dry rice seed off the ground to ensure top quality" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/dry-rice-seed-off-the-ground-to-ensure-top-quality/)

Somali: Si aad u qalajiso abuurka bariiska adigoon u kharribin, ka dhig miis fudud oo kor loo qaaday qoryo ama bambood halkii aad dhulka ku qalajin lahayd; hawadu waxay ku dhaqdhaqaaqi doontaa dhulka hoostiisa si ay u qalajiso si dhakhso badan oo ay u nadiifiso, miiskuna si dhakhso leh ayuu guriga ugu qaadi karaa roobka.
Dholuo: Mondo ipwodh kodhi mar opur ma ok kethre, ti gi yien kata bao e loso mesa ma oting'o gik moko malo kar tedo e lowo; kor lwasi wuotho e yo mayot mondo kodhi obed motegno kendo obed maler, kendo inyalo ting'o mesa mapiyo e ot sama koth chue.

English: To manage cassava mosaic disease: plant only cuttings showing no signs of infection, taken from a clean disease-free field; uproot and bury any plant that develops symptoms as soon as you see them; plant tolerant varieties (in Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); and rotate crops to prevent the disease building up in the soil.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa mosaic ya muhogo: panda vipandikizi tu visivyo na dalili za maambukizi, vilivyochukuliwa kutoka kwa shamba safi lisilo na magonjwa; kung'oa na kuzika mmea wowote unaopata dalili mara tu unapoziona; aina zinazostahimili mimea (nchini Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); na kuzungusha mazao ili kuzuia ugonjwa kuongezeka kwenye udongo.
Source: Farm Radio International, "One head cannot lift a roof (Mutu umodzi susenza denga)" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/one-head-cannot-lift-a-roof-mutu-umodzi-susenza-denga/), Malawi cassava mosaic disease drama

Somali: Si loo xakameeyo cudurka cassava mosaic: ku beero kaliya geedo aan lahayn calaamado cudur, laga soo qaatay dhul nadiif ah oo aan cudur lahayn; xidid iyo aaska dhirta kasta oo horumariya calaamadaha sida ugu dhakhsaha badan ee aad aragto; noocyada u dulqaadanaya dhirta (Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); iyo goosashada dalagga si looga hortago in cudurka uu ku soo kordho ciidda.
Dholuo: Mondo iti gi tuo mar manias: pidh mana yiende ma onge ranyisi mar tuwo, ma ogol e puodho maler maonge tuoche; gol kendo yik yien moro amora ma nigi hinyruok mapiyo kaka iseneno; kit yien ma nigi nyalo mar geng'o tuoche (e piny Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); kendo ti gi yien mopogore opogore mondo kik tuoche omedre e lowo.

English: For a nutritious home-made feed for local chickens (about 8-10 months old), mix roughly: 40% maize or sorghum, 27% bran, 20% oilseed cake (sesame, cotton, or groundnut), plus smaller amounts of fish meal, salt, and mineral premix. Chickens raised on natural feed (not commercial feed with medication) fetch better prices from consumers.
Kiswahili: Kwa chakula chenye lishe cha kuku wa nyumbani (karibu miezi 8-10), changanya hivi: 40% mahindi au sorghum, 27% ya matope, 20% ya keki ya mafuta (sesamu, pamba, au karanga), pamoja na kiasi kidogo cha unga wa samaki, chumvi, na pre-mix ya madini. Kuku zilizolelewa kwa chakula cha asili (sio chakula cha kibiashara na dawa) huleta bei bora kutoka kwa watumiaji.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Preparing feed for local chickens in agroecological ways" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/preparing-feed-for-local-chickens-in-agroecological-ways/), Dodoma Region, Tanzania

Somali: Si aad u hesho cunto nafaqo leh oo guriga lagu sameeyo oo loogu talagalay digaagga maxalliga ah (qiyaastii 8-10 bilood jir), isku qas qiyaastii: 40% galley ama sorghum, 27% bran, 20% keeg saliid ah (sesame, suuf, ama lows), iyo qadar yar oo cunto kalluun, milix, iyo macdanta hore. Digaagga lagu koriyo cunto dabiici ah (ma aha cunto ganacsi oo daawo leh) waxay ka helaan qiimo ka wanaagsan macaamiisha.
Dholuo: Kuom chiemb dhok ma nigi chiemo maber ma itiyogo e ot (higni 8-10), chokuru: cham mar cham ma romo 40% kata sorghum, 27% mar cham ma nigi suya mamit, 20% mar oilseed cake (sesam, koth, kata groundnut), kaachiel gi rech ma nigi makati matin, chumbi, kod gik ma yudore e lowo.

English: To store potatoes longer without them rotting or drying out, layer them with sawdust in a store (alternating layers of sawdust and potatoes, starting and ending with sawdust). The sawdust must be kept moist but not too wet - too dry and the potatoes shrivel and attract pests, too wet and they rot.
Kiswahili: Ili kuhifadhi viazi kwa muda mrefu bila kuoza au kukauka, ziweke na machujo ya mbao kwenye duka (tabaka zinazopishana za machujo ya mbao na viazi, kuanzia na kuishia na machujo ya mbao). Machujo ya mbao lazima yawekwe unyevu lakini sio mvua sana - kavu sana na viazi hunyauka na kuvutia wadudu, mvua sana na huoza.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Sawdust prolongs the storage life of potatoes" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/sawdust-prolongs-the-storage-life-of-potatoes/), Kenya

Somali: Si baradhada loo kaydiyo muddo dheer iyada oo aysan qalamaynin ama u qalajin, ku rid lakabyo alwaax ah dukaanka (lakabyo isdaba joog ah oo alwaax iyo baradho ah, ka bilaab oo ku dhammaato boodka alwaaxda). Boodka alwaaxda waa in la qoyanaa laakiin aan aad u qoyan - aad u qalalan baradhadana way qalalan tahay oo cayayaanka soo jiitaan, aad bay u qoyan yihiin, way qudhmaanayaan.
Dholuo: Mondo kik ng'ato kethre kata kik oyudi, nyaka okan cham gi yien e duka moro (tiende ni, ng'ato ka ng'ato nyaka ketie yien e wi ot machielo, kochakore gi yien e ot machielo kendo bang'e otieko gi yien e ot machielo).

English: To protect stored maize from weevils without chemicals: once cobs are fully dry, remove the kernels, pound the empty cobs into a fine powder, mix this with the kernels, and pack tightly into jute sacks. The powder blocks the weevils' movement so they cannot find new kernels to infest, protecting the maize for up to 12 months.
Kiswahili: Ili kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa kutoka kwa wadudu bila kemikali: mara tu mahindi yamekauka kabisa, ondoa punje, piga cobs tupu kwenye poda laini, changanya hii na punje, na pakia vizuri kwenye magunia ya jute. Poda huzuia harakati za wadudu kwa hivyo hawawezi kupata punje mpya za kushambulia, kulinda mahindi kwa hadi miezi 12.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Innovative farmer uses pounded maize cobs to protect stored maize" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/innovative-farmer-uses-pounded-maize-cobs-to-protect-stored-maize/), Benin

Somali: Si loo ilaaliyo galleyda kaydka ah ee ka hortagga weevil-ka aan kiimikooyin lahayn: marka cobs-ku si buuxda u enegiyo, ka saar geedka, ku garaac cobs-ka madhan si uu u noqdo budo khafiif ah, isku qas tan iyo kernel-ka, kadibna si adag ugu xir bacaha jute-ka. Budadu waxay xannibaysaa dhaqdhaqaaqa weevils-ka si aysan u helin kernels cusub oo ay ku faafaan, taasoo ilaalinaysa galleyda ilaa 12 bilood.
Dholuo: Mondo kik cham ma ne okan-go kethre gi mag chwech mag chwech: ka chwech mag chwechgo osetieko yweyo, onego gologi oko, gichiwgi e powder matin, gichiwgi e chwechgo, kendo gipakgi e sanduge mag jute.

English: To control striga weed, pull it out by hand as soon as it starts flowering and before it produces new seeds; pull carefully so the stem doesn't break, then put the plants in a plastic bag and burn them immediately - do not leave them on the ground, as the tiny seeds will fall and spread. Combine hand-pulling with crop rotation and soil fertilization for better control.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti magugu ya striga, ivute kwa mkono mara tu inapoanza kuchanua na kabla ya kutoa mbegu mpya; Vuta kwa uangalifu ili shina lisivunjike, kisha weka mimea kwenye mfuko wa plastiki na uichome mara moja - usiwaache chini, kwani mbegu ndogo zitaanguka na kuenea. Changanya kuvuta kwa mkono na mzunguko wa mazao na mbolea ya udongo kwa udhibiti bora.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Remove Striga Weeds Carefully from your Field" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/remove-striga-weeds-carefully-from-your-field/)

Somali: Si loo xakameeyo cawska striga, gacanta ku soo saar marka uu bilaabo ubaxa iyo ka hor inta uusan abuur cusub soo saarin; Si taxaddar leh u jiid si geedka uusan u jabin, ka dibna geedka geli bac caag ah oo isla markiiba gub - ha ka tagin dhulka, maadaama abuurka yaryar ay dhici doonaan oo faafi doonaan. Isku dar jiidashada gacanta iyo wareegga dalagyada iyo bacriminta ciidda si loo xakameeyo si wanaagsan.
Dholuo: Mondo idwok lum mar Striga e bwo teko, yudgi gi lweti mapiyo kaka gichako ywayo kendo kapok ginyago kodhi manyien; yudgi maber mondo yadhno kik kethre, kae to iketgi e besen molos gi plastik kendo wang'gi mapiyo - kik iwegi e lowo, nimar kodhi matin biro podho kendo landore.

English: To prevent coccidiosis and mycoplasmosis in poultry, cattle, sheep, and goats: raise feeding and watering troughs above the ground to stop contamination from droppings, and keep livestock sheds dry and clean, since humid, unhygienic conditions favour infection with both diseases.
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia coccidiosis na mycoplasmosis katika kuku, ng'ombe, kondoo, na mbuzi: inua mabwawa ya kulisha na kumwagilia juu ya ardhi ili kuzuia uchafuzi kutoka kwa kinyesi, na kuweka mabanda ya mifugo kavu na safi, kwani hali ya unyevunyevu, isiyo safi inapendelea kuambukizwa na magonjwa yote mawili.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Managing livestock diseases: Mycoplasmosis and coccidiosis" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/managing-livestock-diseases-mycoplasmosis-and-coccidiosis/)

Somali: Si looga hortago coccidiosis iyo mycoplasmosis ee digaagga, lo'da, idaha, iyo riyaha: kor u qaad weelal quudin iyo waraabin ah oo dhulka sare si looga hortago wasakheynta saxarada, sidoo kalena ilaali aqalka xoolaha oo qalalan oo nadiif ah, maadaama xaaladaha qoyan oo aan nadaafad lahayn ay u horseedaan infekshanka labada cudur.
Dholuo: Mondo kik chwany le kod le mag dhok ma nigi kodhi, dhok, rombe, kod diek, kik chwanygi gi tuoche mag apaya: mondo kik gilal gi le mag dhok ma nigi kodhi, nyaka giket kuonde ma ji nyalo pidhoe pi kod pi e wi lowo mondo kik gilal gi gik ma chando le mag dhok.

English: If you use improved fallows (planting a cover crop/shrub to rest and restore land) to improve soil fertility, remember to replace the phosphorus removed when you cut the shrubs before you plant your next crop - add compost or manure, or for best results apply a phosphate fertilizer (such as DAP, SSP, TSP, or rock phosphate).
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unatumia magugu yaliyoboreshwa (kupanda mazao ya kufunika/mimea ya miche ili kupumzika na kurudisha udongo) ili kuboresha uzazi wa udongo, kumbuka kuchukua nafasi ya fosforasi iliyotolewa unapokatua miche kabla ya kupanda mazao yako ya pili - ongeza mbolea au uchafu, au kwa matokeo bora tumia mbolea ya phosphate (kama vile DAP, SSP, TSP, au phosphate ya mwamba).
Source: Farm Radio International, "Farmers who use improved fallows must replace phosphorous in soils" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/farmers-who-use-improved-fallows-must-replace-phosphorous-in-soils/)

Somali: Haddii aad isticmaasho fallows la hagaajiyay (beerista dhir daboolan/geed si loo nasto loona soo celiyo dhulka) si aad u kordhiso bacrinta ciidda, xasuuso inaad beddesho fosfooraska laga saaray markaad jarjarayso dhirta ka hor intaadan beerin dalagga xiga - ku dar compost ama bakhaar, ama natiijada ugu wanaagsan waxaad isticmaashaa bacriminta fosfoofate (sida DAP, SSP, TSP, ama rock phosphate).
Dholuo: Kapo ni itiyo gi yien ma osedok chien (tiyo gi yien ma opong'o lowo mondo omi lowo obed maber kendo obed maber), par ni inyalo kawo kar phosphorus ma ne igolo ka itieko yien ma ne idhi chwoyo kapok ichwoyo yien ma biro biro.

English: As a free, locally-available pesticide for pests and diseases in beans, some farmers grind the leaves of Tephrosia vogelii (known locally by various names), soak them in water for several hours, filter the water, and spray it on both infected and healthy bean plants. Note this method hasn't been scientifically tested for safety, so use with care.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa huru, baadhi ya wakulima husaga majani ya Tephrosia vogelii (yajulikanayo kwa majina mbalimbali), hulowesha maji kwa muda wa saa kadhaa, huchuja maji, na kuyanyunyiza kwenye mimea iliyoambukizwa na inayofaa.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Women farmers use local methods to fight pests and diseases in beans" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/women-farmers-use-local-methods-to-fight-pests-and-diseases-in-beans/), Kigoma Region, Tanzania

Somali: Sida cayayaanka cayayaanka iyo cudurrada cayayaanka ee bilaashka ah ee laga heli karo deegaanka, beeraleyda qaarkood waxay ku dhufanayaan caleemaha Tephrosia vogelii (oo lagu yaqaan magacyo kala duwan oo deegaanka ah), ku qoyaan biyo dhowr saacadood, sifeyn biyo, oo ku buufi dhirta cayayaanka ee cudurka qaba iyo kuwa caafimaad qababa.
Dholuo: Kaka yath ma thiedho kute ma onge chudo kod tuoche ma yudore e puothe, jopur moko chwoyo yien mag Tephrosia vogelii (ma iluongo ni tephrosia vogelii) e alwora margi, gimiyogi pi kuom seche mang'eny, gipogo pi, kendo gipong'o yien ma nigi tuwo kod ma nigi ngima maber.

English: Before planting, clear weeds and dig minimal-disturbance holes for seeds; while crops grow, use natural biopesticides first and chemical pesticides only for stubborn pests; add mulch, compost, and manure to boost soil fertility and retain moisture; and after harvest, rotate to an unrelated crop (for example, beans after maize) to improve soil health and reduce pests and diseases.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kupanda, futa magugu na uchimbe mashimo ya usumbufu mdogo kwa mbegu; wakati mazao yanakua, tumia viuatilifu vya asili kwanza na dawa za kemikali tu kwa wadudu wakaidi; ongeza matandazo, mbolea, na mbolea ili kuongeza rutuba ya udongo na kuhifadhi unyevu; na baada ya kuvuna, zungusha kwa mazao yasiyohusiana (kwa mfano, maharagwe baada ya mahindi) ili kuboresha afya ya udongo na kupunguza wadudu na magonjwa.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Radio spots on circular and regenerative agriculture", Spot #1 (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/radio-spots-on-circular-and-regenerative-agriculture/), Uganda

Somali: Ka hor inta aan la beerin, ka saar cawska oo qod godad aan wax badan lahayn oo abuur ah; inta dalagku korayo, isticmaal biopesticides dabiici ah marka hore iyo sunta kiimikada oo kaliya cayayaanka adkaysiga ah; ku dar mulch, compost, iyo baaqar si loo kordhiyo bacrinta ciidda loona ilaaliyo qoyaan; ka dib goosashada, u beddel dalag aan xiriir lahayn (tusaale ahaan, digir ka dib galleyda) si loo hagaajiyo caafimaadka ciidda loona yareeyo cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.

English: To improve soil fertility and get a source of firewood, plant Gliricidia sepium trees (grown from seed or stem cuttings) in alley rows alongside your crops - space trees 100cm apart within rows, with 5 metres between rows, to allow enough sunlight and easy pruning and harvesting.
Kiswahili: Ili kuboresha rutuba ya udongo na kupata chanzo cha kuni, panda miti ya sepium ya Gliricidia (iliyopandwa kutoka kwa vipandikizi vya mbegu au shina) katika safu za uchochoro kando ya mazao yako - weka miti 100cm mbali ndani ya safu, na mita 5 kati ya safu, ili kuruhusu mwanga wa jua wa kutosha na kupogoa na kuvuna kwa urahisi.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Plant Gliricidia sepium for soil fertility and fuelwood" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/plant-gliricidia-sepium-for-soil-fertility-and-fuelwood/), Eastern Province, Zambia

Somali: Si loo hagaajiyo dhalashada ciidda loona helo isha qoryaha, ku beero Gliricidia sepium geedo (oo laga soo saaray abuurka ama geedo lakabka ah) safka jidadka ah ee dhirtaada - geedo meel u dhexeeya 100cm safka, 5 mitir safka u dhexeeya, si loo oggolaado iftiin qorrax ku filan iyo si fudud loo gooyo iyo goosashada.
Dholuo: Mondo omi lowo obed maber kendo mondo yien obed mang'eny, pidhi yiende mag Gliricidia sepium (ma ipidho gi kodhi kata yiende ma ipidho) e nderni mag udi machiegni gi puothegi - yiende ma nigi tong' 100 cm e kindgi, kendo ma nigi mita 5 e kind tong'go, mondo chieng' orieny kendo obed mayot tong'o kendo keyo.

English: During Uganda's May rains, farmers and communities are advised to monitor weather updates and early warnings, harvest rainwater to maximize agricultural production, secure roofs and structures before storms, and clear drainage channels to reduce flood damage to crops and property.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mvua za Mei za Uganda, wakulima na jamii wanashauriwa kufuatilia sasisho za hali ya hewa na maonyo ya mapema, kuvuna maji ya mvua ili kuongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo, kulinda paa na miundo kabla ya dhoruba, na kusafisha mifereji ya maji ili kupunguza uharibifu wa mafuriko kwa mazao na mali.

Somali: Inta lagu jiro roobabka May ee Uganda, beeraleyda iyo bulshooyinka waxaa lagu talinayaa inay la socdaan cusbooneysiinta cimilada iyo digniino hore, ay urursadaan biyaha roobka si loo kordhiyo wax soo saarka beeraha, la sugo saqafyada iyo dhismayaasha ka hor duufaannada, iyo inay nadiifiyaan kanaalada biyo-mareenka si loo yareeyo waxyeelada daadadka ee dalagyada iyo hantida.
Dholuo: E kinde koth ma koth chue e dwe mar Mei e piny Uganda, ijiwo jopur kod oganda mondo onon weche mag yamo kod siem ma ne ochiw chon, gichop pi koth mondo omi tij pur omed bedo maber, girit ute koda ute ma ne ok nyal yiengni, kendo gipuonj ji mondo oketh yore mag ywayo pi mondo omi koth kod gik moko okethre.

English: To prevent maize downy mildew disease (locally called 'nanzikambe' in Chichewa): till the field deeply before planting, use certified seed from licensed sellers, avoid planting maize near sugarcane, use recommended plant spacing for good airflow, rotate maize with legume crops, and treat seed with Metalaxyl fungicide (6g per kg of seed).
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia ugonjwa wa ukungu wa mahindi (unaojulikana Malawi kama 'nanzikambe'): lima shamba kwa kina kabla ya kupanda, tumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa kutoka kwa wauzaji walioidhinishwa, epuka kupanda mahindi karibu na miwa, panda kwa nafasi inayopendekezwa ili hewa ipite vizuri, badilisha mahindi na mazao ya jamii ya mikunde, na tibu mbegu kwa dawa ya kuvu ya Metalaxyl (gramu 6 kwa kilo ya mbegu).
Source: Malawi Ministry of Agriculture, "Kuzindikira ndi kulimbana ndi matenda a nanzikambe mu chimanga" [Recognizing and fighting downy mildew disease in maize], dodma.gov.mw/newssingle/3

Somali: Si looga hortago cudurka caleemada galleyda (oo si maxalli ah loogu yeero 'nanzikambe' Chichewa): beerta si qoto dheer u beero ka hor inta aan la beerin, isticmaal abuur shahaado leh oo ka yimid iibiyeyaasha ruqsad leh, ka fogow beerista galleyda agagaarka sonkorta, isticmaal kala fogaanshaha dhirta ee la taliyay si hawadu u socoto wanaagsan, beddel galleyda iyo dalagyada digirta, iyo daaweynta abuurka Metalaxyl fungicide (6g halkii kiilo abuur).
Dholuo: Mondo igeng' thieth mar mildew (ma iluongo ni 'nanzikambe' e dho Chichewa): ka pok ipidho puodho, ti gi kodhi molony gi jolok ohala molony, kik ipidhi machiegni gi sukari, iti gi tong' molony mondo omi yien obed gi muya maber, lwok kodhi gi olembe mag legume, kendo thiedhe gi Methalaxyl fungicide (6g kuom kg mag kodhi).

English: If your maize is infected with downy mildew disease: uproot and bury infected plants promptly, avoid walking through infected areas to prevent spreading the disease, remove volunteer sorghum shoots from the field, and after harvest burn or bury crop residues from affected fields; consult your nearest agricultural extension officer for more guidance.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mahindi yako yameshambuliwa na ugonjwa wa ukungu (nanzikambe): ng'oa na uzike mimea iliyoathirika mara moja, epuka kutembea kwenye maeneo yaliyoathirika ili kuzuia kuenea kwa ugonjwa, ondoa machipukizi ya mtama yanayojitokeza yenyewe shambani, na baada ya mavuno choma au zika mabaki ya mazao kutoka mashamba yaliyoathirika; wasiliana na afisa ugani wa kilimo aliye karibu nawe kwa ushauri zaidi.
Source: Malawi Ministry of Agriculture, "Kuzindikira ndi kulimbana ndi matenda a nanzikambe mu chimanga" [Recognizing and fighting downy mildew disease in maize], dodma.gov.mw/newssingle/3

Somali: Haddii hadhuudhkaaga uu ku dhacay cudurka cawska: xididada iyo aaska dhirta ku dhacay si deg deg ah, iska ilaali inaad ku dhex socoto meelaha ku dhacay si aad u ilaaliso faafitaanka cudurka, ka saar caleemaha sargaarka ee beerta, iyo ka dib goosashada gubasho ama aaska hadhuudhka ka hadhay beeraha ku dhacay; la tasho sarkaalka ugu dhow ee kordhinta beeraha si aad u hesho hagitaan dheeraad ah.
Dholuo: Kapo ni cham ma in-go nigi tuwo mar mildew: goluru kodhi ma nigi tuwono mapiyo, kik uwuothi e alwora ma tuwono nitie mondo kik landore, goluru lum mag sorghum e puodho, kendo bang' keyo, wang'uru kata uluru cham ma pod otony e puothe ma ne onegino; tudru gi jatelo ma nono puothe mag puotheu machiegni mondo uyud weche momedore.

English: To avoid buying counterfeit maize seed, look for the scratch-code sticker on the seed packet, scratch it, and send the code to the toll-free verification number to confirm authenticity before planting - as KEPHIS Deputy Director for Seed Certification Ephraim Wachira put it, 'This sticker is what helps farmers distinguish between genuine and fake seed.'
Kiswahili: Ili kuepuka kununua mbegu ghushi za mahindi, tafuta kibandiko cha msimbo wa mwanzo kwenye pakiti ya mbegu, uikwaruze, na utume msimbo kwa nambari ya uthibitishaji isiyolipishwa ili kuthibitisha uhalisi kabla ya kupanda - kama Naibu Mkurugenzi wa KEPHIS wa Udhibitisho wa Mbegu Ephraim Wachira alivyosema, 'Kibandiko hiki ndicho kinachowasaidia wakulima kutofautisha kati ya mbegu halisi na bandia.'
Source: The Standard, "Farmers risk losing half their harvest, agency warns" (standardmedia.co.ke/counties/article/2001547918), quoting KEPHIS Deputy Director for Seed Certification Ephraim Wachira

Somali: Si looga fogaado iibsashada abuurka hadhuudhka been abuurka ah, raadi isku dhejinta lambarka qasacadaysan ee ku yaal baakada abuurka, qasacday, oo u dir lambarka lambarka xaqiijinta lacag la'aanta ah si aad u xaqiijiso xaqiiqda ka hor intaadan beerin - sida ku xigeenka agaasimaha KEPHIS ee shahaadada abuurka Ephraim Wachira uu yidhi, 'Stikhaarkan ayaa ka caawiya beeraleyda inay kala gartaan abuurka dhabta ah iyo kuwa been
Dholuo: Mondo kik ing'iew kodhi mag cham ma ok adier, ne ane kido mar kodhi ma ne ondik e paket kodhi, ndik kode, kendo or kode e namba mar ng'eyo kodhi ma onge chudo mondo ing'e ni kodhi ma ne idwaro chwoyo gin adier - mana kaka Ephraim Wachira ma en jalup mar KEPHIS ma ne tayo tij chwoyo kodhi nowacho niya: 'Kidoni konyo jopur mondo ong'e kodhi ma adier kod kodhi ma ok adier.'

English: To manage bacterial wilt in enset, sterilize cutting tools with 70% alcohol or bleach (or heat them until red-hot) before and after each plant, dig out and bury diseased plants deep in a pit, use disease-free seedlings, rotate with cereal or pulse crops (not banana), and fence the field to keep out animals that can spread the disease.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti kuharibika kwa bakteria katika enset, sterilize zana za kukata na 70% ya pombe au bleach (au joto yao hadi moto nyekundu) kabla na baada ya kila mmea, kuchimba nje na kuzikwa mimea wagonjwa kina kirefu katika shimo, kutumia mbegu zisizo na ugonjwa, kugeuka na nafaka au pulse mazao (si banana), na fence shamba ili kuweka nje wanyama ambao wanaweza kueneza ugonjwa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Controlling bacterial wilt of enset using cultural methods", Created in Ethiopia, August 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800326.pdf)

Somali: Si loo xakameeyo qallaalka bakteeriyada, nadiifi qalabka goynta iyadoo la adeegsanayo 70% aalkolo ama bleach (ama kululeyso ilaa kulul) ka hor iyo ka dib geed kasta, qod oo ku aaso dhirta cudurka leh god qoto dheer, isticmaal geedo aan cudur lahayn, ku beddel dalagyada quraaca ama bakhaarka (ma aha moos), iyo xayndaabka beerta si xayawaanka looga ilaaliyo faafin kara cudurka.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato obed gi tuwo mar bakteria, nyaka oti gi yedhe ma nyap ma romo 70% mar kong'o kata lewni ma loso rangi (kata oti kodgi nyaka gibed maliet) kapok ochako chwoyo kod bang' chwoyo yien, nyaka oyud kendo oyik yien ma nigi tuoche e bur matut, oti gi yien ma onge tuoche, kendo olok yien mag cham kata mag pulse (ok ni gi banana), kendo ogeng' puodho mondo kik onyal kelo tuoche.

English: To manage groundnut rosette disease, plant early with the first good rains (late planting attracts more aphids that spread the virus), use the correct plant spacing, plant resistant varieties (in Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), and uproot and destroy (burn or bury) infected plants.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa rosette ya karanga, panda mapema na mvua nzuri ya kwanza (upandaji wa marehemu huvutia aphids zaidi zinazoeneza virusi), tumia nafasi sahihi ya mimea, aina zinazostahimili mimea (nchini Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), na kung'oa na kuharibu (kuchoma au kuzika) mimea iliyoambukizwa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Management of Rosette in Groundnuts", Created in Malawi, July 2013, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800237.pdf)

Somali: Si loo maareeyo cudurka rosette ee lowska dhulka, beer hore roobka wanaagsan ee ugu horreeya (beerista dambe waxay soo jiidataa aphids badan oo faafiya fayraska), isticmaal kala fogaanshaha dhirta saxda ah, noocyada adkeysiga dhirta (Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), iyo in dhirta cudurka qabta la gooyo oo burburiso (gub ama aaso).
Dholuo: Mondo iti gi tuo mar rosette mar groundnut, pidhe chon ka koth ochue mokwongo (tieko mar pidho cham e kinde mosekalo ywayo kodhino mang'eny ma landho tuwono), ti gi kuonde ma yien okiewo, kit yien ma nyalo geng'o yien (e piny Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), kendo ket yien ma nigi tuwono oko kendo kethgi (tieko kata yikogi).

English: To control fruit flies in mango orchards, make simple traps from small plastic containers with a hanging cotton wick, drench the wick with a 10-20% pesticide solution (such as malathion, fenthion, or deltamethrin) plus a lure like methyl eugenol, and hang the traps in and around the orchard - flies are attracted by the lure and killed by the pesticide.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti nzi wa matunda kwenye bustani za embe, tengeneza mitego rahisi kutoka kwa vyombo vidogo vya plastiki na utambi wa pamba unaoning'inia, loweka utambi na suluhisho la dawa ya 10-20% (kama vile malathion, fenthion, au deltamethrin) pamoja na chambo kama methyl eugenol, na utundike mitego ndani na karibu na bustani - nzi huvutiwa na kivutio na kuuawa na dawa ya wadudu.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Management of fruit flies in mangoes using traps", Created in Malawi, August 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800330.pdf)

Somali: Si loo xakameeyo duqsiyada miraha ee beerta mango-ga, samee dabinno fudud oo ka samaysan weelal yar yar oo caag ah oo leh saxal suuf ah oo la laalaadayo, ku qub dabaqa xalka 10-20% ee sunta cayayaanka (sida malathion, fenthion, ama deltamethrin) iyo qalab la mid ah methyl eugenol, kadibna ku dheji dabinnada gudaha iyo hareeraha beerta - duqsiyada waxaa soo jiitada soo jiidashada oo ay dishaa.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato kik hiny le mag olemo e puothe mag mango, nyaka ogol oboke matindo tindo ma olos gi plastik kendo ogol gi tong' mar bao, omol tong'no gi yath ma nigi ndawa ma romo pasent 10-20 (mana kaka malathion, fenthion, kata deltamethrin) kaachiel gi yath ma nigi suya mamit machalo gi methyl eugenol, kae to ogol oboke e puothno.

English: Banana Xanthomonas wilt is not yet in Ghana, but if you spot it: immediately uproot infected plants, cut them into pieces and bury deep away from the farm; remove the male bud with a forked stick (not a cutlass) before it opens; disinfect farm tools with 10% bleach or fire; and never take planting material (suckers) from an infected farm.
Kiswahili: Mnyauko wa ndizi Xanthomonas bado haujawa Ghana, lakini ukiiona: mara moja kung'oa mimea iliyoambukizwa, ikate vipande vipande na uzike mbali kabisa na shamba; ondoa bud ya kiume na fimbo iliyopigwa (sio cutlass) kabla ya kufungua; disinfect zana za shamba na 10% bleach au moto; na kamwe usichukue nyenzo za kupanda (suckers) kutoka kwa shamba lililoambukizwa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "How to Recognise Banana Xanthomonas Wilt", Created in Ghana, May 2016, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800917.pdf)

Somali: Xanthomonas bananaska ayaa weli ku dhiman Ghana, laakiin haddii aad aragto: isla markiiba xidid geedo qaba cudurka, gooyooyin u gooyo oo si qoto dheer uga qodo beerta; ka saar burooyinka labka ah ee la furay (oo aan ahayn cutlass) ka hor inta aysan furmin; qalabka beeraha ku jeermis qalabka 10% bleach ama dab; oo marnaba ka qaado qalabka beeraha (suga) beerta ku dhacay.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni banana Xanthomonas ok yud tho e piny Ghana, to ka ifwenyo ni nitie, to onego: ng'ad oko piende ma nigi tuoche, ing'adgi matindo tindo kendo ikwalgi mabor gi puodho; gol puodhono gi tong' moting'o tong' (to ok tong' moting'o tong'), kapok oting'o tong'no; thiedh gik ma itiyogo e puodho gi gik ma loso puodho gi gik ma loso remo kata mach ma romo 10%.

English: To limit the spread of eucalyptus gall wasp, never transport or distribute seedlings from an infected nursery to disease-free areas, remove and burn affected plant parts and fallen leaves (especially September-November), and be aware that registered chemical treatments for this pest are not yet available in Ethiopia.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza kuenea kwa nyumbu ya gall ya eucalyptus, kamwe usafirishe au usambaze miche kutoka kwa kiota cha watoto kilichoambukizwa kwenda maeneo yasiyo na magonjwa, ondoa na kuchoma sehemu za mimea iliyoathiriwa na majani yaliyoanguka (haswa Septemba-Novemba), na ujue kuwa matibabu ya kemikali yaliyoorodheshwa kwa wadudu hawa bado hayapatikani Ethiopia.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Eucalyptus gall wasp (Blue gum chalcid)", Created in Ethiopia, October 2015, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167801209.pdf)

Somali: Si loo xaddido faafitaanka eucalyptus gall wasp, marnaba u soo gudbi ama u qaybi geedo ka soo jeeda xanaanada cudurka ku dhacay meelaha aan cudurka lahayn, ka saar oo gub qaybaha dhirta ee saameeyay iyo caleemaha dhacay (gaar ahaan Sebtember-Noofembar), iyo inaad ogaato in daaweynta kiimikada ee diiwaangashan ee cayayaanka aan weli laga heli karin Itoobiya.
Dholuo: Mondo omi thieth mar eucalyptus gall wasp kik medre, kik idhi gi kodhi mag yiende ma nigi tuoche kata kik ipoggi kuonde ma onge tuoche, gol oko kendo wang'o kuonde ma yiende osedwarore kod yiende ma osepodho (e wi mago duto, Septemba kod Novemba), kendo ng'e ni e piny Ethiopia pok nitie yore mag thieth ma nigi kemia ma ok oket e bwo chik.

English: To manage boron deficiency in pawpaw, apply 5-10kg of well-decomposed manure per plant annually at the start of the rainy season, and apply 0.5-5g of Borax fertilizer around the base of young plants; for mature plants, a foliar spray of water-soluble boron corrects the deficiency faster than soil application.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti upungufu wa boroni katika pawpaw, tumia 5-10kg ya mbolea iliyoharibika vizuri kwa kila mmea kila mwaka mwanzoni mwa msimu wa mvua, na tumia 0.5-5g ya mbolea ya Borax karibu na msingi wa mimea ya vijana; kwa mimea ya kukomaa, dawa ya majani ya boroni ya maji huondoa upungufu haraka kuliko matumizi ya udongo.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Prevention of boron deficiency in pawpaw", Created in Malawi, July 2018, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20197800173.pdf)

Somali: Si loo xakameeyo yaraanta boron ee pawpaw, isticmaal 5-10kg oo baashin si fiican u burburay geedkiiba sannadkii bilowga xilliga roobka, iyo 0.5-5g bacriminta Borax ah salka dhirta da'da yar; Dhirta bisil, buufin caleen ah oo boron biyaha ku milma ayaa si dhakhso ah u saxda yaraanta marka loo eego isticmaalka ciidda.
Dholuo: Mondo omi yadh boron orum e pawpaw, onego iti gi yien moro ka moro ma nigi choke mag boron kuom kilo 5-10 e higa ka higa e chakruok mar kinde koth, kendo iti gi yien moro mar borax kuom kilo 0.5-5 e bwo tiend yien matindo; kuom yien motegno, yath ma nigi boron ma nyalo lokore e pi loso yadh boron mapiyo moloyo kaka itiyogo e lowo.

English: Plant certified seeds using the correct planting methods - as KALRO Director Robert Musyoki puts it, this is 'the best way' to address Kenya's food deficit; certified seeds 'guarantee improved productivity and resilience,' according to KALRO Research Officer Samuel Kiiru.
Kiswahili: Panda mbegu zilizoidhinishwa kwa kutumia njia sahihi za kupanda - kama Mkurugenzi wa KALRO Robert Musyoki anavyosema, hii ndiyo 'njia bora' ya kushughulikia upungufu wa chakula nchini Kenya; mbegu zilizoidhinishwa 'zinahakikisha tija na uthabiti,' kulingana na Afisa Utafiti wa KALRO Samuel Kiiru.
Source: Kenya News Agency, "Plant certified seeds to enhance food Security, KALRO urges farmers" (kenyanews.go.ke/plant-certified-seeds-to-enhance-food-security-kalro-urges-farmers-2/), quoting KALRO Director Robert Musyoki and Research Officer Samuel Kiiru

Somali: Ku dhis abuurka la shahaado iyadoo la adeegsanayo hababka beeritaanka saxda ah - sida uu sheegay agaasimaha KALRO Robert Musyoki, tani waa 'habka ugu fiican' ee lagu xallin karo yaraanta cuntada Kenya; abuurka la shahaado 'waxay damaanad qaadeysaa wax soo saar iyo adkeysi sare', sida uu sheegay sarkaalka cilmi baarista ee KALRO Samuel Kiiru.
Dholuo: Nyak kodhi ma osenyis ni ok nyal chuer ka gitiyo gi yore makare mag pidho - kaka jatend KALRO Robert Musyoki wacho, mano e ' yo maberie moloyo ' mar tieko yuto mar chiemo e piny Kenya; kodhi ma osenyis ni ok nyal chuer ' miyo nyak kod teko mar nano medo bedo maber, ' kaka jatend KALRO Samuel Kiiru wacho.

English: To control nematodes in tomatoes without chemicals, plant Red Sunhemp (2kg seed per lima) in the field 3-3.5 months before growing tomatoes - its roots release a chemical that repels nematodes. Remove or plough in the Sunhemp plants after harvesting their seed, then plant your tomatoes.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti nematodes katika nyanya bila kemikali, panda Red Sunhemp (mbegu ya kilo 2 kwa lima) shambani miezi 3-3.5 kabla ya kukua nyanya - mizizi yake hutoa kemikali ambayo hufukuza nematodes. Ondoa au lima kwenye mimea ya Sunhemp baada ya kuvuna mbegu zao, kisha panda nyanya zako.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Red Sunhemp against nematodes in tomatoes", Created in Zambia, August 2013, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20147801411.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.88; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.626; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.331
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo nematodes ee yaanyada aan lahayn kiimikooyinka, ku beeri Red Sunhemp (2kg seed per lima) berrinka 3-3.5 bilood ka hor inta aan la beeriyo yaanyada - xididdadeeda waxay sii deynayaan kiimiko ka hortagayaaya nematodes.
Dholuo: Mondo omi inyal geng'o nematode e tomato maok nigi gik ma kelone chamo, pidie Red Sunhemp (kg 2 mag kodhi kuom lima) e puodho dweche 3 - 3.5 kapok ipidho tomato - tiendgi golo gima kelo chamo ma chango nematode.

English: To manage black Sigatoka in bananas, check your field weekly from planting until the tree matures. If you see an infected leaf, cut it carefully, bag it, and burn or bury it away from the field; if a whole tree is badly infected, cut it down and destroy it immediately. Always clean your tools with ethanol, bleach, or fire between uses.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Sigatoka nyeusi katika ndizi, angalia shamba lako kila wiki tangu kupanda hadi mti ukomavu. Ikiwa unaona jani lenye maambukizi, likatikane kwa uangalifu, lifungue, na ulichome au ulilifiche mbali na shamba; ikiwa mti mzima umeambukizwa vibaya, ukate na kuharibu mara moja. Daima safisha zana zako kwa ethanol, beluch, au moto kati ya matumizi.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Reducing Black Sigatoka in your Banana field", Created in Congo (DRC), May 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800101.pdf)
