Somali: Si aad u maamusho Sigatoka madow ee mooska, hubi beertaada toddobaadle laga bilaabo beerista ilaa geedku bislaaado. Haddii aad aragto caleen cudur leh, si taxaddar leh u jar, bacda geli, oo gub ama ku aaso meel ka fog beerta; HADII GEED DHAN SI XUN U CAABUDO, JAR OO ISLA MARKIIBA BURBURI. Mar walba nadiifi qalabkaaga ethanol, bleach, ama dab inta u dhaxaysa isticmaalka.
Dholuo: Mondo iti gi Sigatoka ma rateng' e olembe, ne puodho juma ka juma chakre ipidho nyaka chop yadh ochop. Kapo ni ineno yath moro ma nigi tuwo, ng'iye maber, igole e bag, kendo wang'e kata ikwane oko; ka yath mangima nigi tuwo marach, ng'iye piny kendo iketh oko mapiyo. Kinde duto luok gige tich gi ethanol, whitewash, kata mach e kind kinde ma itiyogo.

English: To protect stored maize from insect pests using an airtight metal silo: load only clean, dry maize (13% moisture or less), place a lit candle inside on a tray, then seal the silo. The candle burns up the oxygen and goes out on its own (5-20 minutes), and the resulting low-oxygen environment kills the insects without chemicals.
Kiswahili: Ili kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa dhidi ya wadudu wadudu kwa kutumia silo ya chuma isiyopitisha hewa: pakia mahindi safi tu, kavu (unyevu 13% au chini), weka mshumaa uliowashwa ndani kwenye trei, kisha uzibe silo. Mshumaa huchoma oksijeni na kwenda peke yake (dakika 5-20), na mazingira ya chini ya oksijeni huua wadudu bila kemikali.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Grain storage in metal silos against insect pests", Created in Zambia, July 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800264.pdf)

Somali: Si loo ilaaliyo hadhuudhka kaydsan cayayaanka iyadoo la adeegsanayo silo bir ah oo aan hawada u adkeyn: ku shubi kaliya hadhuudh nadiif ah oo qalalan (13% qoyaan ama ka yar), ku rid shumac iftiimiya gudaha saxan, ka dibna xidh shumaca. Shumaca ayaa gubaya oksijiin waxayna si gooni gooni ah u baxdaa (5-20 daqiiqo), waxaana deegaanka oksijiin yar ee soo baxa uu dilaa cayayaanka iyada oo aan la helin kiimikooyin.
Dholuo: Mondo igeng' kodhi ma ne okan-go kik hiny chuech mamoko, ti gi silos mar chuma ma ok rum: ting'e mana kodhi maler (13% mar yuto kata matin) kae to iket kandel moting'o mach e otas, kae to ing'i silosno.

English: To manage bacterial black spot in mango, prune off and destroy diseased twigs (sterilizing your tools between cuts), spray copper oxychloride-based products as soon as the disease appears nearby - before it infects your trees. Avoid spraying during fruit set, and do not enter the orchard for at least a day after spraying.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti doa nyeusi la bakteria kwenye embe, kata na uharibu matawi yenye ugonjwa (kusafisha zana zako kati ya kupunguzwa), nyunyiza bidhaa za oksikloridi ya shaba mara tu ugonjwa unapoonekana karibu - kabla ya kuambukiza miti yako. Epuka kunyunyizia dawa wakati wa kuweka matunda, na usiingie kwenye bustani kwa angalau siku baada ya kunyunyizia dawa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Copper against bacterial black spot in mango", Created in Zambia, December 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800022.pdf)

Somali: Si aad u maareyso dhibcaha madow ee bakteeriyada ee mango, gooyo iyo baabi'iyo laamo xanuunsan (oo qalabkaaga u dhigaya midho la'aan inta u dhaxaysa goynta), ku buufi waxyaabaha ku saleysan copper oxychloride isla marka cudurka uu soo muuqdo meel u dhow - ka hor inta uusan ku dhaawicin geedahaaga. Ka fogow buufinta inta lagu jiro go'aanka miraha, oo ha gelin beerta miraha ugu yaraan maalin ka dib buufinta.
Dholuo: Mondo itiek tuwo mar bakteria e mango, ng'ad oko bede ma nigi tuoche kendo ikethgi (tiyo gi yorego e kind tongego), ka tuoche ma kamago oneno machiegni, to piyo gi gik ma nigi copper oxychloride kapok gichako mako yiende.

English: To control mango pulp weevil, harvest fruits earlier than usual (before fully ripe), and remove and bury fallen fruit debris at least 50cm deep (or compost it under at least 1m of other material) to stop weevils hatching and reinfesting the crop.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti weevil ya massa ya embe, vuna matunda mapema kuliko kawaida (kabla ya kuiva kabisa), na uondoe na uzike uchafu wa matunda ulioanguka kwa kina cha angalau 50cm (au uiweke mbolea chini ya angalau 1m ya nyenzo zingine) ili kuzuia wadudu kuanguliwa na kurejesha mazao.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Cultural control of mango pulp weevil", Created in Zambia, July 2015, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800147.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.801; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.471; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.2
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo weevil-ka mango pulp, goosto miraha ka hor inta aan caadiga ahayn (ka hor inta aysan si buuxda u bislaan), kadibna ka saar oo ku aaso qashinka miraha dhacay ugu yaraan 50cm qoto dheer (ama isku daro ugu yaraan 1m walxo kale) si looga joojiyo cayayaanka inay dillaacaan oo dib u faafidaan dalagga.
Dholuo: Mondo ng'ato otang' gi ng'injo mag mango, nyaka ochok olemo chon moloyo kaka ne itimo chon (ka pok ochie chuth), kendo nyaka ogol oko kendo oyike e bor mar chamo olemo ma osepodho ma dirom sentimita 50 (kata otere e bwo mita 1 mar gik mamoko) mondo ogeng'o ng'iendno kik yieng' kendo kik ochak oyud olemo kendo.

English: To control anthracnose in African eggplant, buy a Mancozeb-based fungicide from a registered agro-dealer (avoid Mancozeb-Metalaxyl mixes), mix 40g per 20 litres of water plus 2 tablespoons of liquid soap as a sticker, and spray mid-morning or late afternoon avoiding wind and drought-stressed plants; observe a two-week pre-harvest interval.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti anthracnose katika biringanya ya Kiafrika, nunua dawa ya kuua kuvu inayotokana na Mancozeb kutoka kwa muuzaji wa kilimo aliyesajiliwa (epuka mchanganyiko wa Mancozeb-Metalaxyl), changanya 40g kwa lita 20 za maji pamoja na vijiko 2 vya sabuni ya maji kama kibandiko, na nyunyiza katikati ya asubuhi au alasiri kuepuka mimea inayofadhaika kwa upepo na ukame; Zingatia muda wa wiki mbili kabla ya mavuno.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Protect African eggplant from anthracnose", Created in Zambia, September 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800027.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.723; qa_tool_somali=azure; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.596; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.182
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo anthracnose-ka ee eggplant-ka Afrika, iibso fungicide ku saleysan Mancozeb oo ka timid ganacsade diiwaangashan oo beeraha ah (ka fogow isku-darka Mancozeb-Metalaxyl), isku qas 40g 20 litir biyo kasta iyo 2 qaado saabuun dareere ah sida sticker, kadibna ku buufi subaxda dhexe ama galabtii dambe si looga fogaado dabaysha iyo dhirta abaarta dhibaataysan tahay; La soco laba toddobaad ka hor goosashada.
Dholuo: Mondo ichung' ne ng'ato e kit ngima mar ng'ato, ng'iewo thieth mar thowi mar Mancozeb e ng'at ma loso gik moko e yor thieth (kik icham gik ma nigi thieth mar Mancozeb-Metalaxyl), ikonye gi pi mar 40g kuom lita 20 mar pi kaachiel gi supuni ariyo mag sabun ma nigi teko kaka sticker, kendo imaye thieth e chuny okinyi kata bang' odhiambo mondo kik ichak chwoyo yiende ma yamo kod oro omako.

English: To control powdery mildew in okra without synthetic chemicals, pound 1.5kg of fresh neem leaves and soak in 16 litres of water for 24 hours, sieve, add 50g of soft soap as a sticker, then spray the whole plant, repeating after 2 weeks if symptoms persist. Stop spraying 10-14 days before harvest.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ukungu wa unga kwenye bamia bila kemikali za syntetisk, pauni kilo 1.5 za majani safi ya mwarobaini na loweka kwenye lita 16 za maji kwa masaa 24, ungo, ongeza 50g ya sabuni laini kama kibandiko, kisha nyunyiza mmea mzima, ukirudia baada ya wiki 2 ikiwa dalili zitaendelea. Acha kunyunyizia siku 10-14 kabla ya kuvuna.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Neem extract to control powdery mildew in okra", Created in Zambia, September 2016, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20177800425.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia; qa_tool=azure; qa_roundtrip=0.722; qa_tool_somali=nllb; qa_roundtrip_somali=0.649; qa_tool_dholuo=nllb_selfcheck; qa_roundtrip_dholuo=0.252
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo cawska budada ah ee okra oo aan lahayn kiimikooyin sintetik ah, 1.5 kg caleemo cusub oo neem ah oo lagu qoyo 16 litir oo biyo ah 24 saacadood, silig, ku dar 50 g oo saabuun jilicsan oo ah isku dhejiyaha, ka dibna buufi dhirta oo dhan, oo la soo celiyo 2 toddobaad kadib haddii calaamadaha sii socdaan. Jooji buufinta 10-14 maalmood ka hor goosashada.
Dholuo: Mondo omi oketh mol mol e okra maonge gik ma loso chwech, onego iti gi mogo ma romo kilo 1.5 mag neem manyien kendo imegi pi mar lita 16 kuom seche 24, imegi sabun ma romo gram 50 kaka adhesiv, kae to imegi yath duto, kae to imigi manyasi bang' jumbe 2 ka nyoso mana.

English: To control Kapinga (Bermuda grass) in maize fields, spray glyphosate on actively growing weeds a few days after rain (240ml per 16L water) before planting, then plant maize a day or more later; before or after maize germinates, spray Atrazine over moist soil (320ml per 16L water). Always follow label instructions and wear protective equipment.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Kapinga (nyasi za Bermuda) katika mashamba ya mahindi, nyunyiza glyphosate kwenye magugu yanayokua kikamilifu siku chache baada ya mvua (240ml kwa maji 16L) kabla ya kupanda, kisha panda mahindi siku moja au zaidi baadaye; kabla au baada ya mahindi kuota, nyunyiza Atrazine juu ya udongo wenye unyevunyevu (320ml kwa maji 16L). Daima fuata maagizo ya lebo na uvaa vifaa vya kinga.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Kapinga management with herbicides in maize", Created in Zambia, July 2017, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20177801256.pdf)

Somali: Si loo xakameeyo Kapinga (cawska Bermuda) ee beeraha galleyda, ku buufi glyphosate cawska firfircoon koraya dhowr maalmood kadib roobka (240ml halkii 16L biyo) ka hor inta aan la beerin, kadibna galleyda beer maalin ama ka badan kadib; ka hor ama ka dib dhalashada galleyda, ku buufi Atrazine dhul qoyan (320ml biyo kasta oo 16L ah). Had iyo jeer raac tilmaamaha calaamadda oo xiro qalabka ilaalinta.
Dholuo: Mondo omi kik cham mar Kapinga (Bermuda grass) chakre e puothe mag kodhi, ng'ato onego okaw glyphosate e lum ma dongo e yo ma ratiro bang' ka koth osechwe (240 ml kuom pi 16L) bang' ndalo matin kapok ochwoyo, kae to ogol kodhi bang' odiechieng' achiel kata mokalo kanyo; kapok kodhi owuok, kata bang'e, ng'ato onego okaw Atrazine e lowo motwo (320 ml kuom pi 16L).

English: Ahead of a forecast dry spell, Kenya's Meteorological Department and agriculture ministry advise crop farmers to heavily mulch their fields, practice minimum tillage, construct tied ridges, and invest in rainwater harvesting structures to conserve soil moisture.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kipindi cha ukame kinachotabiriwa, Idara ya Hali ya Hewa na wizara ya kilimo ya Kenya wanawashauri wakulima wa mashamba yao waweke mashamba mengi, wafanye kazi ya kulima, wajenge vilima vilivyofungwa, na wawekeze katika miundo ya kukusanya maji ya mvua ili kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo.
Source: Kenya Meteorological Department, monthly climate advisory reported in "Farmers Told to Conserve Moisture as Kenya Met Predicts Cold, Dry Conditions Throughout July" (kenyans.co.ke/news/124954)

Somali: Ka hor inta aanay jirin xilliga qalalan ee la saadaalinayo, Waaxda Cimilada Kenya iyo wasaaradda beeraha waxay ku talinayaan beeraleyda inay si weyn u beeraan beerahooda, u dhaqmaan beerashada ugu yar, dhisaan buundooyin la xiray, oo ay maalgashadaan dhismayaasha soo uruurinta biyaha roobka si loo ilaaliyo qoyaanada ciidda.
Dholuo: Ka pok ochopo kinde ma piny biro bedo ma onge yiengni, ofis mar Kenya mar Meteorology kod ofis mar pur jiwo jopur mondo opidh puothegi gi yiengni mang'eny, oti gi puothe ma ok nyal pong'o yiengni, oger kuonde ma ji nyalo ng'adoe yiengni, kendo oti gi yore mag choko pi koth mondo omi lowo kik bed gi pi mang'ich.

English: Ahead of a forecast dry spell, livestock keepers - especially in Kenya's arid and semi-arid areas - are advised to conserve existing fodder, manage water supplies carefully, and shield animals from temperature extremes.
Kiswahili: Hapo awali, walinzi wa mifugo, hasa katika maeneo yenye ukame ya Kenya, wanashauriwa wahifadhi chakula cha mifugo, wasimamie maji kwa uangalifu, na kulinda wanyama kutokana na joto kali.
Source: Kenya Meteorological Department, monthly climate advisory reported in "Farmers Told to Conserve Moisture as Kenya Met Predicts Cold, Dry Conditions Throughout July" (kenyans.co.ke/news/124954)

Somali: Marka ay ka hortagto abaarta la saadaalinayo, xoolaha xoolaha - gaar ahaan meelaha qalalan iyo kuwa nus-qalalan ee Kenya - waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ilaaliyaan hilibka jira, si taxadar leh u maareeyaan biyo, iyo inay xoolaha ka ilaaliyaan heerkulka daran.
Dholuo: Ka pok piny ochwe, jodongo ma pidho jamni - to ahinya wuon e gwenge ma piny Kenya otwo ahinya - jiwo ahinya mondo girit chiembgi, giti maber gi pi, kendo giritgi kik lietre ahinya.

English: Harvest tomatoes in the early morning or late evening when the temperature is around 20C and the weather is dry. For storage, keep tomatoes at 12C and 86-90% relative humidity - they spoil if kept below 10C for over 2 weeks, or below 5C for more than 6-8 days, but can last 2-3 weeks at 10C or above.
Kiswahili: Vuna nyanya asubuhi na mapema au jioni wakati joto ni karibu 20C na hali ya hewa ni kavu. Kwa kuhifadhi, weka nyanya kwa 12C na unyevu wa jamaa wa 86-90% - huharibika ikiwa zimehifadhiwa chini ya 10C kwa zaidi ya wiki 2, au chini ya 5C kwa zaidi ya siku 6-8, lakini zinaweza kudumu wiki 2-3 kwa 10C au zaidi.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Backgrounder: Reducing post-harvest losses in tomatoes" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-reducing-post-harvest-losses-in-tomatoes/)

Somali: Goosashada yaanyada subaxdii hore ama galabtii dambe marka heerkulku yahay qiyaastii 20C iyo cimiladauna ay qalalan tahay. Kaydinta, yaanyada ku hay 12C iyo 86-90% qoyaan isbarbardhig ah - way burburayaan haddii la hayo ka hooseeya 10C muddo ka badan 2 toddobaad, ama ka hooseeya 5C muddo ka badan 6-8 maalmood, laakiin waxay socon karaan 2-3 toddobaad 10C ama ka sarreeya.
Dholuo: Tego pomade gokinyi mang'ich kata godhiambo ka liet mar piny chiegni 20C kendo yamo riyo.

English: Leaving common bean roots in the soil after harvest adds an extra 20-60kg of nitrogen per hectare, available for the next crop - equivalent to 3/4-2 free bags of urea. With good agricultural practices, common bean can yield over 800kg per acre.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuvuna, mizizi ya maharage hubakia kwenye udongo na huongeza kilo 20-60 zaidi za nitrojeni kwenye udongo kwa hekta moja, ambayo itatumika kwa zao litakalofuata - sawa na mifuko 3/4-2 zaidi ya urea. Kwa kutumia mbinu sahihi za kilimo bora cha maharage, mavuno yanaweza kuwa zaidi ya kilo 800 kwa ekari.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Backgrounder: Growing common bean" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-growing-common-bean/, Swahili: scripts.farmradio.fm/sw/mwongozo-wa-redio/nakala-juu-ya-kilimo-cha-maharage/), Tanzania

Somali: Marka la tago xididdada caadiga ah ee caanaha ee ciidda ka dib goosashada waxay ku dartaa 20-60 kg oo nitrogen ah halkii hektar, oo loo heli karo goosashada soo socota - oo u dhiganta 3/4-2 bacaha bilaashka ah ee urea.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato oweyo tiend nyinyo e lowo bang' keyo, to omedo nitrogen ma romo kilo 20 - 60 e hekta ka hekta, ma nyalo yudore e cham ma biro - ma romre gi ng'injo mag urea ma romo 3/4 - 2.
